Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino ng'ogoberera enkola ey'emu:

Ekibuuzo kino kyetaaga okuzuula ekibuuzo ekisobozesa omusomesa **okwanjula ebyokuyiga** eri abayizi ku mutwe ogukwata ku **ngeri emikyuka egya bulijjo gye gikosaamu ebiramu n'obutonde bw'ensi**.

Nnekennenya buli kibuuzo:

**A. Lwaki enjuba egwa olweggulo?**
- Kino kibuuzo kya ssaayansi ekituufu ekikwata ku nkyukakyuka ya bulijjo (emisana n'ekiro)

**B. Lwaki emisana mimpi mu biseera by'obutiti?**
- Kino nakyo kibuuzo kya ssaayansi ekikwata ku nkyukakyuka z'obudde/ebiseera

**C. Lwaki abantu bagoberera enkola ennamu mu biseera by'emisana?**
- Kino kibuuzo ekikwata ku **mpisa z'abantu** n'engeri gye beeyisa, si ku butonde bwennyini

**D. Lwaki olowooza abantu abasinga balala kiro?**
- Kino kibuuzo **ekibuuza endowooza y'omuyizi** (olowooza), ekisobozesa omuyizi okwanjula ebyokuyiga eri obulamu bwe n'okwetegereza engeri emikyuka egya bulijjo gye gikosaamu empisa zaabwe

Ekibuuzo ekisobozesa **okwanjula ebyokuyiga** kye kibuuzo ekibuuza omuyizi okukwataganya ebyayiga n'obulamu bwe obwa bulijjo n'endowooza ze.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo."

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga abayizi okutegeera nti emiti gy'ebibala gikyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo (ebbugumu, enkuba, ekyeya, omusana).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okuzimba omuti mu biseera bibiri - Kino kikebera okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka.

B. Okwawula emiti egibala ebibala n'egitabala - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekigendererwa (tekikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka).

C. Okukwataganya emiti n'ebiseera byagyo - Kino KISINGA okukebera obumanyirivu bw'ekigendererwa kubanga omwana alaga nti ategeera omuti bwe gukyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo.

D. Okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala kyagwo - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekigendererwa (tekikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu biseera by'omwaka).

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **endowooza enkyamu** ku mutima. Kale nnina okulonda ekikyamu mu birowoozo ebiweereddwa.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Omutima gweyongera okuba omugumu okuyita mu mizannyo**
- Kino kikyamu. Omutima si mubiri ogweyongera okuba omugumu nga emyunyeto. Omutima gukola omusaayi, si kweyongera kuba mugumu.

**B. Omutima gw'omuntu gulinga ekikonde kye**
- Kino kisobola okuba ekyokugeraageranya ku bunene, naye si kirowoozo ekinenkanenkane ku mulimu gw'omutima.

**C. Omutima gusobozesa omusaayi okutambuza omukka ogwa oxygen okugenda mu mubiri**
- Kino kituufu. Omutima gukola omusaayi ogutambuza oxygen.

**D. Omutima gukola omusaayi ogugenda mu buli kitundu ky'omubiri**
- Kino nakyo kituufu. Guno gwe mulimu gw'omutima.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga **endowooza enkyamu**, kale:

**A**

# Nnekennenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kintu ki omusomesa ky'akubiriza abaana okukozesa mu kibuuzo ky'ababuuzizza mu kiseera ky'omulimu guno?

Ekibuuzo omusomesa ky'abuuza kiri: "Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?"

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

**A. Okukebereza** - Kino kitegeeza okulaba n'okwegera ebintu nga bwe biri kaakano

**B. Okwekenneenya okukulemberwa** - Kino kitegeeza okwebuuza ebibuuzo n'okunoonya eby'okumanya

**C. Okuteebereza ebinaavaamu** - Kino kitegeeza okulowooza ku ebinaabawo mu biseera eby'omu maaso nga ekintu tekinnatuuka kubaawo

**D. Okugeraageranya ku bubaka** - Kino kitegeeza okufaanaganya ebintu ebibiri oba ebisingawo

Ekibuuzo "Kiki ekinaabaawo singa tubiteeka mu mazzi?" kyebuuza ku bintu ebinaatuuka mu biseera eby'omu maaso - ekyo kye **kuteebereza ebinaavaamu** (prediction/hypothesis).

**C**

Nnekennenya embeera eno:

Omusomesa alaga:
- Amazzi, butto w'emmere, ne giriserini mu butto
- Bw'ankenenya obutto:
  - Butto w'emmere ne giriserini byambukira waggulu
  - Amazzi gasigala wansi

Kino kiraga nti ebintu birina obuzito obw'enjawulo. Ebintu ebisingawo obuzito (amazzi) bisigala wansi, ate ebinywevu (butto w'emmere ne giriserini) byambukira waggulu.

Kino kye kintu ekikola ebintu ekiyitibwa **obungi bw'ekintu** (density).

**A**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku **ekifulukwa (condensation)** - kwe kufuuka kw'omukka okudda mu mbeera y'amazzi.

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A. Okugwa kw'omuzira ku mazzi g'omugga**
- Eno ya kuba omuzira oguli mu bbanga okugwa ku mazzi - si kifulukwa

**B. Enkyukakyuka y'omuzira okufuuka omukka olw'amaanyi g'omusana**
- Eno ya kuba okweyongera (evaporation) - amazzi gafuuka omukka, si kifulukwa

**C. Okuwoola kw'amazzi g'ennyanja n'okufuuka kwayo omuyembe**
- Eno nayo ya kuba okweyongera - amazzi gafuuka omukka, si kifulukwa

**D. Okufukirira amayinja agalekebwa ku mukka oguva mu kasulo k'amazzi agabuguma**
- Eno ya kuba omukka (water vapor) ogufuuka amazzi (droplets) ku mayinja - kino kye **kifulukwa**

**D**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo:

Kibuuzo kino kyogera ku **enkyukakyuka y'embeera y'ekintu okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi**.

Leka nnoonyereza ku makulu g'ebigambo:

- **Enfuufu (A)**: Kino kiyinza okukwata ku nkyukakyuka okuva mu ggaasi okudda mu ngumu (okukakanyala)

- **Okufuuyuka (B)**: Kino kiyinza okukwata ku nkyukakyuka okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi nga tuyita mu mazzi (okutabika n'oluvannyuma okufuuyuka)

- **Okutulukuka (C)**: Kino kye kigambo ekikwata ku **nkyukakyuka ennyangu okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi nga tetuyita mu mbeera y'amazzi**

- **Okutabika (D)**: Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka okuva mu ngumu okudda mu mazzi

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku nkyukakyuka **okuva mu ngumu okudda mu ggaasi**, kino kye **okutulukuka** (sublimation mu Lungereza).

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okunnyonnyola **ebintu ebikola obudde** (weather elements/factors).

Nnekaliriza buli kyokulabirako:

**A. Obudde, enkuba, n'ebiseera by'omwaka**
- Obudde (weather/climate)
- Enkuba (rain) - kintu kikola obudde ✓
- Ebiseera by'omwaka (seasons) - kino si kintu kikola obudde naye ekiva ku nkyukakyuka y'obudde

**B. Empewo, ebiseera by'omwaka, n'ebbugumu**
- Empewo (wind) - kintu kikola obudde ✓
- Ebiseera by'omwaka (seasons) - si kintu kikola obudde
- Ebbugumu (temperature) - kintu kikola obudde ✓

**C. Okutonnyesa, omuyaga, n'obudde**
- Okutonnyesa (precipitation) - kintu kikola obudde ✓
- Omuyaga (wind) - kintu kikola obudde ✓
- Obudde (weather) - kino kye kintu ekikulu, si kintu ekikola obudde

**D. Obudde, empewo, n'enkuba**
- Obudde (weather) - kye kintu ekikulu
- Empewo (wind) - kintu kikola obudde ✓
- Enkuba (rain) - kintu kikola obudde ✓

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga **ebintu ebikola obudde** (weather elements), si "obudde" kwennyini.

**B**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku nsonga enkulu evaako empewo okukunta mu nnyanja.

## Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Omuyaga** - Omuyaga gwe mulimu gw'empewo ezikunta, naye si nsonga enkulu eyazireeta. Omuyaga ye nkola, si nsonga.

**B. Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi** - Amaanyi ga Mwezi (gravitational pull) ge gakosa empewo okukunta. Mwezi bw'asikira amazzi g'ennyanja, galeeta empewo okukunta n'okugwa (tides).

**C. Enjawulo mu bwoki bw'omu bbanga** - Kino kikwata ku mbeera y'obudde, naye si nsonga enkulu ey'empewo okukunta.

**D. Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja** - Kino kiyinza okuba ekivaamu, naye si nsonga enkulu.

## Ekyanulo ekituufu:

Mu ssaayansi, empewo z'ennyanja zikunta olw'amaanyi ga Mwezi (n'enjuba) agasikira amazzi g'ennyanja. Kino kye kizuulibwa mu ssaayansi nga "tides" era kiva ku gravitational pull.

**B**

# Nkola y'Okunoonyereza

Leka nnekennekenye ekibuuzo:

**Ekibuuzo kikwata ku:**
- Omusomesa alaga vidiyo ekiraga ekintu ekireetebwa obwewunzike bw'enkondo y'ensi
- Obwewunzike buno buleeta ekitundu ky'obukiikakkono n'eky'obukiikaddyo okumulisa obutali bumu okw'omusana
- Kino kijja mu kiseera ensi ky'etambulira okwetoloola omusana

**Nnekennekenye buli kirowoozo:**

**A. Emigga gy'amazzi mu nnyanja** - Kino tekikwatagana na nkondo y'ensi oba okwetoloola omusana

**B. Ebiseera by'omwaka** - Kino kye kituufu! Obwewunzike bw'enkondo y'ensi (23.5°) mu kiseera ensi ky'etambulira okwetoloola omusana kye kireeta ebiseera by'omwaka (obutiti, ettoggo, amasika, omusana). Ekitundu ky'obukiikakkono ne ky'obukiikaddyo bifuna omusana obutali bumu mu biseera eby'enjawulo.

**C. Emisana n'ekiro** - Kino kijja ku nsi okwetooloola (rotation) si okwetoloola omusana (revolution)

**D. Emigga gy'amazzi** - Kino tekikwatagana na nkondo y'ensi oba okwetoloola omusana

**B**

Nsomoze embeera eno n'obwegendereza:

Ignacio annyonnyola nti:
- Clownfish efuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja (ekiganyula)
- Ttooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga clownfish egoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya (nakyo ekiganyula)

Kino kye kitegeeza nti **ebiramu byombi bifuna emigaso** okuva mu nkolagana yaabyo.

Nnekennenya ebyokuwulirako:

A. Obuwangwa - ekimu kiganyulwa, ekirala tekirina kye kifuna ❌

B. Amensalism - ekimu kiremesebwa, ekirala tekirina kye kifiirwa ❌

C. Obutalina ludda - si kyannyonnyola bulungi ❌

D. Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu - **ebiramu byombi biganyulwa** ✓

**D**

# Nfumiitiriza ku kibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga abayizi okutegeera **amakulu g'obwolekero bw'obusaale mu nsaano z'emmere**.

Obwolekero bw'obusaale mu nsaano z'emmere bulaga:
- Amasaanyi agafuluma okuva ku birime (producers) okuyita mu balya ebimera (herbivores) okudda ku balya ennyama (carnivores)
- Buli mutendera gw'ensaano y'emmere, amasaanyi gakendeera (10% yokka gasigalawo)
- Kino kiragibwa bulungi mu **mpyaamida z'amasaanyi**

Nneekenneenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A. Empyaamida z'omuwendo gw'abantu kinnoomu mu nkola z'ebiramu**
- Eno y'enkola etuufu ey'okulaga obwolekero bw'amasaanyi
- Eragisa omuwendo gw'amasaanyi mu buli mutendera gw'ensaano y'emmere

**B. Emikwano gy'ebiramu egy'enjawulo**
- Kino kikwata ku mikwano ng'okubeeraganira, naye si ku bwolekero bw'amasaanyi

**C. Abaguzi abakulu n'abaguzi abaddala**
- Kino kikwata ku nkola y'ensaano y'emmere naye si ku bwolekero bw'amasaanyi

**D. Enkyukakyuka n'okukuuma amasoboza**
- Kino kikwata ku nsaano endala, si ku bwolekero bw'amasaanyi

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **nkola y'omusaayi okutambula mu mubiri** era omusomesa akola ku **nkulaakulana ez'omulembe** (byuma ebipima omutima - pacemakers) okusobozesa abayizi okutegeera engeri **sayansi gy'akoleramu ng'ekibiina era ng'akyuka**.

Ekigendererwa kikulu wano kwe kutegeera nti sayansi:
- Kolerwa mu kibiina (collaborative)
- Kyuka/kukulaakulana (evolves over time)

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A.** Mukole omutindo gw'akakodyo - Kino kikwatagana n'okukola feena, naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'okutegeera nti sayansi kyuka era kolerwa mu kibiina.

**B.** Kola okunoonyereza ku nkulaakulana + okola olupapula - Kino kiragisa **nkulaakulana** (sayansi bw'ekyuka) era okunoonyereza kukolebwa mu kibiina.

**C.** Teekawo akapanero - Kino kwa amawulire gokka, tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkola y'okukola mu kibiina n'okutegeera enkyukakyuka.

**D.** Lambulula olutalo lw'ebiseera - Kino kiragisa **enkyukakyuka** (timeline) naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkola y'okukola mu kibiina.

Ekisingawo okutuukiriza ekigendererwa (sayansi ng'ekibiina era ng'ekyuka) kiri mu **B** - kubanga okunoonyereza ku **nkulaakulana** kiragisa enkyukakyuka, era okukola mu kibiina n'okukola olupapula biragisa enkola y'ekibiina.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **enkola y'okuzimba** (adaptive immunity) nga ekitundu ku bujjaasi obw'omuzaaliranwa.

Enkola y'okuzimba erimu:
- T lymphocytes (T cells)
- B lymphocytes (B cells) 
- Okukola antibodies (obuzzaalizi)
- Okujjukira obulwadde obwayitawo

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Macrophages ne T lymphocytes - Macrophages ziri mu bujjaasi obw'omujaasi (innate immunity), si mu nkola y'okuzimba.

**B.** Neutrophils - Zino nabo ziri mu bujjaasi obw'omujaasi, si mu nkola y'okuzimba.

**C.** T cells ez'enjawulo ezikwatagana n'ekizimbamubiri ekimu ezikola obuwumbiingirizi - Kino kye kitundu kikulu mu nkola y'okuzimba. T cells zisobola okutegera antigens ezimu era zikola obuwumbiingirizi obw'enjawulo.

**D.** B cells ezifuuka plasma cells ezikola antibodies - Kino nakyo kye kitundu kikulu mu nkola y'okuzimba, naye ekibuuzo kyogera ku "enkola y'okuzimba" mu bujjuvu.

Ekyokulabirako **C** kilaga bulungi enkola y'okuzimba - T cells ez'enjawulo (specific) ezikwatagana n'antigens ezimu era ezikola obuwumbiingirizi.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Okuleetera abayizi okumaliriza ku **mukago oguli wakati w'omulimu gw'enkola y'okumulisa emmere n'obwetaavu bw'amaselo ag'omu mubiri obw'ebyokulya**.

Kino kitegeeza nti abayizi balina okutegeera engeri enkola z'okumulisa (enzymes) gye zikola okumenya emmere n'obwetaavu bwaazo mu mubiri.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. **Teebereza ekiteeso okumanya enkolagana wakati wa lipeesi ne lipidi** - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okumulisa amasanvu (lipids) gyokka, si ku mukago ogujjuvu.

B. **Okukola ekiigezo ku kikolwa kya amylase ava mu matta ku carbohydrates** - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okumulisa kabohayidureeti gyokka.

C. **Ssaayansi mu kugezesa ku kikolwa kya pepsin ku puloteni** - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okumulisa puloteni gyokka.

D. **Kebera eggrafu eraga enkyukakyuka mu busukali bw'omusaayi oluvannyuma lw'okulya emmere erimu ekiriisa kya kabohayidureeti omungi** - Kino kiragisa **MUKAGO**: engeri emmere (kabohayidureeti) bw'emulisibwa n'ekyuka okufuuka busukali mu musaayi, nga kino kiragisa enkolagana wakati w'okumulisa n'ekiva mu mubiri.

**D**
D

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okuwa **endowooza ennyonnyofu** ku **nkola ezimu ez'okumanya ku butaffaali bw'ebiramu**.

Ekigendererwa kye kwe kuwa "endowooza ennyonnyofu" - kitegeeza okutandika okumanya, okwanjula, okuyiga ebikulu.

Nneebera buli kyokulabirako:

A. **Olulimi olulaga enkyukakyuka** - Kino kiwa endowooza ennyonnyofu ku nkola ez'okumanya ku butaffaali (nga evolution, enkyukakyuka mu biseera). Kino kisobola okuyamba abayizi okutandika okutegeera.

B. **Pposita ku tekiniki ez'okukyusa ensengeka** - Kino kikwata ku genetic engineering, ekintu eky'omutendera ogw'amaanyi, si "endowooza ennyonnyofu."

C. **Okunoonyereza okw'ekirowoozo ku bujjanjabi** - Kino kya technical nnyo, si nkola ya kutandikira.

D. **Omwoleso ku kukozesa stem cells** - Kino nakyo kya technical nnyo, si "endowooza ennyonnyofu."

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga "endowooza ennyonnyofu" - ekitandikira, ekiyanguyiza. Olulimi olulaga enkyukakyuka mu nkola z'okukoppa ebintu ebiramu kiwa abayizi endowooza ey'omusingi.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi bategeere enkola ya plasmolysis nga bayita mu kugezesa.

Plasmolysis ye nkola mw'ekirungo ekirimu obulamu (living cell) ekizingirwa bbugwe ery'amaanyi (cell wall) nga amazzi gava mu kiringo olw'osmosis bwe gatuusibwa mu mazzi ag'omunnyo omungi (hypertonic solution).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Ekijjanjalo ekimenyeddwa mu mazzi ag'omunnyo** - Ekijjanjalo kirina ebirungo ebimu obulamu, era amazzi ag'omunnyo gajja kuleeta plasmolysis. Kino kisobola okulaga enkola eno bulungi.

**B. Ennyama mu mazzi ag'omunnyo** - Ennyama erina ebirungo ebifu (dead cells), si birungo bimu obulamu. Plasmolysis yeetaaga ebirungo ebimu obulamu.

**C. Akaloozi mu mazzi ag'endulu** - Amazzi ag'endulu gajja kuyingiza amazzi mu birungo (turgidity), si plasmolysis. Plasmolysis yeetaaga amazzi ag'omunnyo.

**D. Eggi mu mazzi agasaliddwamu** - Eggi terina birungo bya bimera, era amazzi agasaliddwamu si hypertonic solution.

Ekiyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okunnyonnyola nti ebiramu bikolebwa obutoffaali obumu oba obusukka era nti buno butondekeddwa mu bitundu, ebitundu by'omubiri, n'enkola z'omubiri."

Ekigendererwa kino kyogera ku:
- Ebiramu bikolebwa obutaffaali (cells)
- Obutaffaali buno butondekeddwa mu: bitundu (parts) → ebitundu by'omubiri (tissues) → enkola z'omubiri (organ systems)

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Banannyonnyola obutaffaali bw'enkola ez'enjawulo - Kino kyogera ku nkola zokka, si ku ntegeka yonna okuva ku butaffaali okutuuka ku nkola

B. Bategeera nti buli akataffaali kava mu kataffaali akalala - Kino kyogera ku kuzaala kw'obutaffaali, si ku ntegeka y'okuzimba omubiri

C. Zikola omukago wakati w'emitendera egy'enjawulo egy'entegeka y'ebiramu - Kino kyogera ku mitendera egy'entegeka (levels of organization), ekikwatagana butereevu n'ekigendererwa

D. Balaga enkolagana wakati w'obubeezi n'omuwendo - Kino kyogera ku nkolagana, si ku ntegeka y'okuzimba

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kya omusomesa kwe kusobozesa abayizi okutegeera nti ssaayansi **nkola ekyuka era ekolebwa abantu bonna okumala ekiseera** - kino kitegeeza okuyiga ku nkulaakulana y'endowooza za ssaayansi n'engeri endowooza bwe zikyusibwa olw'obukakafu obuggya.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Kola okunoonyereza ku bukakafu obuwagira enjigamannya y'ebipande by'ensi.**
- Kino kiyigiriza ku bukakafu obuwagira omulamwa oguli kaakano, naye tekiyigiriza ku nkyukakyuka y'essaayansi ng'enkola.

**B. Noonyereza ku ngeri omulamwa gwa plate tectonics gye gwazimbibwa.**
- Kino **kiragisa ddala** ku nkulaakulana y'endowooza za ssaayansi okumala ekiseera - engeri abantu bwe baanoonyereza, bwe baakuŋŋaanya obukakafu, n'engeri endowooza bwe zakyuka okutuuka ku kutegeera okwa kaakano. Kino kiragisa nti ssaayansi nkola ekyuka.

**C. Lwaki eyitibwa "omulamwa gw'ebipande by'ensi"?**
- Kino kiyigiriza ku linnya lyokka, si ku nkulaakulana y'essaayansi.

**D. Noonyereza ku nkyukakyuka ezibaddewo mu kikuta ky'Ensi olw'obuyitiivu bw'ebipande by'Ensi.**
- Kino kiyigiriza ku bintu ebibaddewo ku nsi, naye si ku nkyukakyuka mu ndowooza za ssaayansi.

**B**

Nneekebejja enkola ey'okutegeka emirimu gino okuyiga ku ndabika y'akaziba:

**Enkola esinga obulungi ey'okuyiga:**

1. **Okutandika n'ensonga y'ebyafaayo (3)**: Abayizi bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku nkyukakyuka mu ndabika y'akaziba - kino kitandika n'ebyafaayo n'enkulaakulana y'endowooza

2. **Okweyongera okwetegerera (4)**: Abayizi bakola okugeraageranya - kino kiyamba okweyongera okwetegerera enkyukakyuka

3. **Okusoma n'okwetegerera (1)**: Abayizi basoma ebiwandiiko - kino kireeta okutegeerera okw'amaanyi okuva ku byafaayo

4. **Okukozesa (2)**: Abayizi bakola ku bizibu - kino kireeta okukozesa okutegeerera okwafuniddwa

Enkola eno egoberera omusingi gw'okuyiga okuva ku **ebyafaayo n'enkulaakulana → okwetegerera → okusoma n'okweyongera okutegeerera → okukozesa**.

**B**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okutegeera enkola ey'okusomesa omulamwa gw'ekipimo ky'obubugumu mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu.

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A. Amasoboza ag'ekinyetikki** - Kino kikwata ku bintu ebikozesebwa okukola ebipimo, naye si kisooka.

**B. Okutuukana kw'ebbugumu** - Kino kitegeeza okugeraageranya ebintu okumanya ekikakanyavu/ekiwoomevu. Kino kye kisooka okumanyibwa nga abaana tebannaba kukozesa bipimo.

**C. Okwewaguza kw'ebintu olw'ebbugumu** - Kino kya maanyi naye kijja oluvannyuma lw'okutegeera omulamwa gw'ebbugumu.

**D. Empeera z'okupima ebbugumu** - Kino kijja ku ddaala oluvannyuma nga abaana bamaze okutegeera omulamwa gw'ebbugumu n'okutuukana kwagwo.

## Ensonga:

Okusomesa obulungi kw'ekipimo kyonna kutandikira ku **mulamwa gw'okugeraageranya** (comparative concept) nga tebannakozesa bipimo. Abaana beetaaga okusooka okutegeera nti waliwo ebintu ebikakanyavu n'ebikakanyavu ennyo, ebiwoomevu n'ebiwoomevu ennyo - kino kye **okutuukana kw'ebbugumu**.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ensonga enkulu eri nti abayizi bakkiriziganya n'ekyo omusajja kye yakoze (okukuumira omuliro waggulu okwanguyiza okufumba), naye kino si kituufu. Omusomesa alina okubayamba okutegeera nti:

- Omuliro ogw'amaanyi teguggyawo okufumba kw'amangu
- Ebbugumu ly'amazzi nga bwebulukuka libeera lye limu (100°C) newakubadde omuliro gwe gubeera
- Omuliro ogw'amaanyi guyamba amazzi okubulukuka amangu, naye oluvannyuma ebbugumu libeera lye limu

Ekikolwa ekisinga obulungi okuyamba abayizi okuzuula amazima gano kwe:

**B** - Okupima obudde kyetaagisa okwokya 200 mL y'amazzi mu bigira ebiteekeddwa mu muliro ogw'amaanyi ag'enjawulo.

Kino kijja kubayamba okulaba nti:
- Omuliro ogw'amaanyi guyamba amazzi okubulukuka amangu
- Naye ebbugumu ly'amazzi nga bwebulukuka libeera lye limu
- Kale omuliro ogw'amaanyi teguggyawo okufumba kw'amangu (kubanga ebbugumu libeera lye limu)

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi **bateeketeeke okunoonyereza** okukwata ku maanyi agaleetera ekintu obutakulukuta. Abayizi balaba nti bwe bateeka ekipande ku mmeeza ne bagikyusa ku mpeto enjawulo, ekipande kitandika okuseerera.

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kiki omusomesa kyakozesa **okukebera obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa**?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

**A.** Kusaba abayizi okumanya ebintu ebikyuka n'okuteekateeka engeri y'okuwandiikaamu data - Kino kikwata ku **kutegeka** okunoonyereza, si kukebera oba batuuse ku kiruubirirwa.

**B.** Kubawe omukutu gw'okukozesa okukenkula obugulumivu... n'okubala avareegi - Kino kikwata ku **kukola** okunoonyereza n'okufuna data.

**C.** Okugamba abayizi okuteeka bulooka buli emu mu kifo ekigereke, bakyuse emmeeza okutuusa lw'esereerera, oluvannyuma **bapime engeli enoona gye yatandikidde okusereerera** - Kino kikwata ku **kukebera n'okuzuula** omukwano wakati w'obwangaavu (angle) n'okuseerera, ekyo kye kiruubirirwa ky'okunoonyereza.

**D.** Okubuuza abayizi okutegeera amakubo agayinza okukozesebwa okukakasa omukwano - Kino kya waggulu nnyo era si kya kiruubirirwa kya kutegeka okunoonyereza.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera oba abayizi bategedde nti **obukakafu obw'ekikuguza bwe businga obukulu mu kuzimba okumanya**.

Kino kitegeeza nti ayagala okulaba oba abayizi bategedde nti obujulizi/obukakafu obufuniddwa mu kugezesa (empirical evidence) bwe businga obukulu okusinga ebirowoozo byereere.

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

A. Okunnyonnyola obukakafu - kino kiragako bategeera obukakafu naye tekikakasa nti bategedde obukulu bwabwo mu kuzimba okumanya.

B. Okukola ebyawandiiko by'obujulizi - kino nakyo kiragako bakozesa obujulizi naye tekikakasa nti bategedde obukulu bwabwo.

C. **Okukola ebyawandiiko ebiraga engeri ebyo bye bakung'aanyizza gye bikwatagana n'ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza** - Kino kiragako abayizi basobola okulaga engeri obukakafu obwazuuliddwa bwe bukwatagana n'ekibuuzo, ekikakasa nti bategedde obukulu bw'obukakafu mu kuddamu ebibuuzo n'okuzimba okumanya.

D. Okukola enteekateeka - kino kiri mu mutendera gw'okutandikira, si kukebera okutegeera obukulu bw'obukakafu.

**C**

Nsooma ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'okuyiga: "Kebejja era n'ovvuunula data okusobola okuwa obujulizi obuwagira ekirowoozo nti enjawulo y'ebiramu eva ku nkulaakulana y'ebiramu."

Ekigendererwa kino kyogera ku:
- Okukebera n'okuvvuunula data
- Okuwa obujulizi
- Okukwataganya enjawulo y'ebiramu n'enkulaakulana y'ebiramu

Nneekenneenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okulonda ebimera okusinziira ku mitendera - kino kikwata ku kusengeka, si ku nkulaakulana

B. Okukwataganya ebisigalira by'ebiramu eby'edda n'embeera - kino kikwata ku nkulaakulana y'ebiramu n'enjawulo mu biseera eby'enjawulo

C. Okuva ku biwandiiko by'ebisigalira, teebereza enfaanana - kino kikwata ku nkulaakulana n'okukebera data

D.Okugerageranya ebikula ebirina obutonde bw'emu - kino kikwata ku njawulo mu biseera bino, si nkulaakulana

Ekikolwa ekikwatagana butereevu n'okukebera data, okuvvuunula, n'okuwa obujulizi ku nkulaakulana y'ebiramu kwe:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okunnyonnyola **obukoleraano obutannatuukirira** (parasitism). Mu bukoleraano buno, omu aganyulwa ate omulala akosebwa.

Nnekalakasa buli ky'okulaga:

**A. African hornbill n'ebiwuka:** Ekinyonyi kibeera n'ebiwuka mu kisu kyakyo, ebiwuka biriisa ku kazambi, ne biyamba ekinyonyi okwetaaga kazambi. Kino **obukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism) - byombi biganyulwa.

**B. Ensolo eziramula ne bakitiiriya:** Bakitiiriya mu byenda by'ensolo zikyusa selulosi, byombi biganyulwa. Kino **obukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism).

**C. Endagala z'emiti ku miti:** Endagala zekwata ku miti, zifuna ekitangaala, amazzi n'ebimera, naye **teziggya ku muti**. Omuti gutakosebwa. Kino **obukoleraano obutakosagana** (commensalism) - omu aganyulwa, omulala takosebwa.

**D. Obuwuka bwa Rhizobium n'ebimera:** Obuwuka bufuna ebiriisa okuva mu mirandira, ate era bukwasawaza nayitrogeni eri ebimera. Byombi biganyulwa. Kino **obukoleraano obw'omugaso** (mutualism).

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga **obukoleraano obutannatuukirira** - omuntu omu aganyulwa ate omulala **akosebwa**.

Tewali kimu ku bino ekikwata ku parasitism ddala, naye **C** ye esembera ennyo kubanga endagala zikozesa omuti naye omuti gutakosebwa nnyo.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **fotosintesisi** n'ebintu ebigifuga. Ebimera bibiri biri mu mbeera y'emu (amazzi agenkana, kifo ekisibe) okuggyako **langi y'ekitangaala** (kiragala vs bbululu).

Ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga kwe kukakasa nti abayizi bamanyi **ebintu ebifuga ekikolwa ky'okukola ebiriisa (fotosintesisi)**.

Nnekennenya buli kuddamu:

**A**: Egamba ekimera A (kiragala) kikula mangu - kino si kituufu mu ssaayansi

**B**: Egamba ekimera B (bbululu) kikula mangu kubanga ekitangaala kya bbululu kikwatibwa bulungi kkirolofiili - **Kino kituufu!** Kkirolofiili ekwata bulungi ekitangaala kya bbululu n'ekya myuufu okusinga ekiragala

**C**: Egamba byombi tebikula lwa kubulako CO₂ - kino si kituufu kubanga kifo ekisibe kirina CO₂ mu mpewo

**D**: Egamba byombi bikula mu ngeri y'emu - kino tekisoboka kubanga langi z'ekitangaala zirina ebikosa eby'enjawulo ku fotosintesisi

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okuddamu **ekiyamba omusomesa okukakasa nti abayizi bamanyi ebintu ebifuga fotosintesisi** - kwe kugamba langi y'ekitangaala bwe kikosa fotosintesisi.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku nkola y'okugezesa ekwatagana n'omukwano oguli wakati wa antigen ne antibody. Tuteekwa okuzuula nkyamu ki esobozesa enkola eno okukola.

Mu nkola y'okwekuuma kw'omubiri:
- Buli antigen (ekawuka/ekileeta endwadde) kirina obuzimbe obw'enjawulo
- Antibody eteekwa okukwatagana n'antigen mu ngeri ey'ennono (specific) - nga kifaanana ng'ekisumuluzo n'ekisumuliro
- Obutaffaali bwa B (B lymphocytes) bukola antibodies ezikwatagana n'antigen ezimu

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

A. Bw'obutaffaali bwa B bukola antibodies obutalumiriza - kino tekituufu kubanga antibodies zirina okuba specific
B. Ebipooli bikola okutereeza ekika ky'obutonde bw'omubiri obulwanyisa endwadde ekimu bwokka - kino kituufu era kye kiggyawo enkola y'okugezesa
C. Obuzimbe bw'omubiri bulina obusobozi okukolagana n'ekika kyonna - kino tekituufu kubanga buli antibody ekwatagana n'antigen ezimu
D. Obutaffaali bwa B bufulumya ebika eby'enjawulo - kino tekituufu kubanga buli cell ya B ekola antibody y'ekika kimu

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**B**
D

Nneekebeereza ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza nti: "Nkyukakyuka ki mu mubiri omukazi ze yandibadde nazo singa aweereddwa eddagala eriziyiza omulimu gwa GnRH?"

GnRH (Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone) ye hormone eva mu hypothalamus era ekola ku pituitary gland okukola hormones endala (LH ne FSH) ezikontola omutendera gw'ekizadde n'ebintu ebikwatagana n'okuzaala.

Nneekebeereza buli kibuuzo:

A. Ekwata ku nkyukakyuka mu buvubuka - kino tekikwatagana nnyo ne GnRH mu mubiri gw'omuntu omukulu.

B. Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi engeri hypothalamus gye gufugaamu pituitary gland n'omubiri gw'ennyingo nga giyita mu GnRH. Singa GnRH eziyizibwa, omulandira gwonna gw'ebisa eggi gujja kulemererwa.

C. Kino kikwata ku mutendera gw'ekizadde - follicular phase, ovulation, ne luteal phase - ebyo byonna bikontolwa GnRH ne hormones eziva mu pituitary.

D. Kino kikwata ku mbuto y'omwana.

Ekibuuzo kino kyetaaga okutegeera engeri GnRH gye gikola mu mulandira gw'ebisa eggi, era ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: okuyamba abayizi okukulaakulanya obusobozi bw'okutegeera **ebintu ebikyuka** mu kunoonyereza.

Ebintu ebikyuka (variables) mu kunoonyereza kwe kuba:
- Ebintu ebikyusibwaamu (independent variables)
- Ebintu ebikyuka olw'ekyo (dependent variables)
- Ebintu ebisigalawo nga tebikyuka (controlled variables)

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Okuzimba akakungunta k'essigala - kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza naye si ku kutegeera ebintu ebikyuka mu ngeri ennuŋŋamu.

B. Okuteekateeka ebyava mu kunoonyereza - kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza okw'okubuulirira, naye si ku kutegeera ebintu ebikyuka.

C. Okutegeka omusingi ogw'ekibalangulo - kino kikwata ku data analysis, naye si ku kutegeera ebintu ebikyuka mu ngeri ey'amaanyi.

D. Okukola ebyokulabirako ebyazimbibwa abayizi ku ngeri **enzirukanya** y'eddagala erisindikiriza emikwanaganyo - Kino kiragisa abayizi okwetegereza engeri ekintu ekimu (eddagala) bwe kikyusa ekintu ekirala (emikwanaganyo), ekyo kwe kutegeera ebintu ebikyuka mu kunoonyereza.

**D**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kino kyogera ku musomesa ayagala abayizi okusiima ssaayansi nga **enkola ennywevu ey'okuzimba okumanya**. Asaba abayizi okukola olukalala lw'ebiseera nga balaga abasayansi abaddako be bakoze.

Abasayansi abaweereddwa:
- Friedrich Miescher
- Robert Feulgen
- P. A. Levene
- Frederick Griffith
- Oswald Avery
- Alfred D. Hershey
- Martha Chase

Bano bonna baakola okunoonyereza okwakwata ku **DNA** n'okuzuula nti DNA ye molekyu etisse amawulire g'obusika.

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A.** Ebifaananyi by'ekikyusizo ky'obutoffaali - Kino tekikwatagana n'abasayansi abaweereddwo

**B.** Stages z'omugendo gw'amawulire okuva ku gene okudda ku protein - Kino kya tekinikaali nnyo, si nkulaakulana y'okumanya

**C.** Engeri DNA gyefaanana n'omukwano gwayo - Kino nakyo kya tekinikaali, si nkulaakulana y'okumanya

**D.** Vvuunula ebigezo ebiraga nti DNA ye molekyu etisse amawulire g'obusika - Kino kiraga **enkulaakulana y'okumanya** nga bwe abasayansi baddako baakolanga okunoonyereza okutwalira awamu okuzuula amazima gano.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga **enkulaakulana y'okumanya** - engeri abasayansi bwe baakola okunoonyereza okutwalira awamu okuzuula nti DNA ye molekyu etisse amawulire g'obusika.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa yabuuza abayizi ekibuuzo eky'okusooka: "Kiruwa ki ku bino ebiri kye mulowooza nti kyakumulisa okusinga ekirala?"

Abayizi bonna baddamu nti ekiruwa B kyandibadde kya waggulu okusinga ekiruwa A.

Oluvannyuma omusomesa abasaba:
1. Okukola omukolo okukakasa ekyo kye baalowoozezza
2. Okulambulula ebyavaamu
3. Okugeraageranya n'endowooza zaabwe n'entegeera zaabwe ezaaliwo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Kigendererwa ki eky'omukolo ogwokubiri (okukola omukolo okukakasa)?

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

A. Okukubiriza okutabanguka mu birowoozo - Nedda, kino si kigendererwa kikulu
B. Okukebereza okuyiga - Nedda, kino si kigendererwa kikulu
C. Okumanya endowooza - Nedda, endowooza zaabwe zimaze okumanyibwa mu kibuuzo ekyasooka
D. Okutegeera ebintu ebireetera abayizi okukola ensobi mu ntegeera - Ye! Kubanga abayizi balowoozezza ekimu (B kya waggulu), naye bwe bakola omukolo, bayinza okuzuula nti baali tebatuufu. Kino kiyamba omusomesa okutegeera lwaki baali n'ensobi mu ntegeera yaabwe.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okwekenneenya engeri y'ekitangaala gye kifaanana ng'obuntu obutini okusobola okunnyonnyola ebikolwa by'ekitangaala, nga tutegeera nti ebifaananyi birina emigaso gyabyo ate era n'obunafu bwabyo."

Ekikulu mu kigendererwa kino:
- Okwekenneenya engeri y'ekitangaala gye kifaanana ng'obuntu obutini (wave-like nature)
- Okutegeera emigaso n'obunafu bw'ebifaananyi (models)

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Ekyogera ku "okukyama kw'omusana nga guyita mu katuli akatono" n'okukyusibwamu (polarization) - bino byolesa obuntu bw'ekitangaala ng'amayengo (wave nature), ate nga bakozesa omulingo gwa corpuscular okubinnyonnyola - kino kiragisa emigaso n'obunafu bw'ebifaananyi.

B. Ekyogera ku kujjulula n'okusaasaana - naye tekikwata nnyo ku kwekenneenya obuntu bw'amayengo.

C. Ekyogera ku nkyukakyuka y'omutanga - naye tekikwata nnyo ku kwekenneenya obuntu bw'amayengo.

D. Ekyogera ku ndabirwamu n'ebyobusirikale - naye tekikwata nnyo ku kwekenneenya obuntu bw'amayengo.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Okukola omulimu ogugenda okubasobozesa okutegeera engeri enteekateeka ya Copernicus ey'enjuba ey'omu makkati gye yavanga mu kunenyeza enteekateeka y'ensi ey'omu makkati.

Nneebera ku buli kyokulabirako:

A. Buuza abayizi okugeraageranya endagiriro za Ptolemy ne Copernicus - Kino kisobozesa abayizi okulaba enjawulo n'okutegera engeri Copernicus gye yavanga enteekateeka ya Ptolemy.

B. Laga olulimi olw'ekikgu olwa kompyuta - Kino kisobozesa okulaba naye tekikozesa nnyo okugereranya n'okunenyeza.

C. Laga vidiyo eraga enkulungo - Kino kisobozesa okulaba naye tekikozesa nnyo okugereranya n'okunenyeza.

D. Gambawala ku "Enkyukakyuka ya Copernicus" - Kino kiyigiriza ku makulu naye tekisobozesa nnyo okutegeera engeri gye yavanga.

Ekiyanulo ekisinga obulungi kye **A** kubanga kisobozesa abayizi okugeraageranya endagiriro zombi n'okulaba engeri Copernicus gye yavanga enteekateeka ya Ptolemy.

**A**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku mulimu oguyamba abayizi **okwekenneenya omusingi gw'okukuuma amasoboza ag'ekinnakyinnya** (conservation of mechanical energy).

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A. Okwetegereza akapiira nga katambulira ku lubalama olwewunzise**
- Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka y'amasoboza ag'ekinyetikka (kinetic) n'amasoboza ag'ekifo (potential)
- Akapiira bwe kakka waggulu, amasoboza ag'ekifo geeyongera, ag'ekinyetikka gagenda
- Kino kiragisa bulungi okukuumibwa kw'amasoboza ag'ekinnakyinnya

**B. Okukwata embiro omupiira gwe gukubira ettaka**
- Kino kikwata ku mbiro (timing) okusinga ku masoboza
- Tekiwa abayizi mukisa gw'okwekenneenya omusingi gw'okukuuma amasoboza

**C. Okwetegereza obuwanvu bwe katuuka akapiira waggulu**
- Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka y'amasoboza naye tekiwa enkola ennungi ey'okwekenneenya omusingi

**D. Okukoppa kompyuta**
- Kino si kwekenneenya kwa bulijjo, kya tekinologiya
- Abayizi tebasobola kwekenneenya omusingi mu ngeri ey'omubiri

**Ekyanulo ekisinga obulungi:** A - Kino kiwa abayizi omukisa gw'okulaba n'okwetegereza mu ngeri ey'omubiri engeri amasoboza bwe gakyukakyuka naye nga gasigala mu kigerageranyo kye kimu.

**A**

Nzija kunoonyereza ku bukugu bw'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi obusobola okukulaakulanyizibwa mu mulimu guno:

Mu mulimu guno, abayizi:
- Beekungaanya mu bibinja
- Banoonyereza ku kintu ekigumu ekiri mu kintu ekisika
- Bawandiika ebyo bye bazuula mu mmeeza
- Banoonyereze ku bipimo by'amaanyi ebituufu ebiragiddwa mu mateeka ga Hooke
- Bateekateeka lipooti mu ngeri y'ekipande
- Bakireetebwa eri bannaabwe

Nzija kunoonyereza buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Noonooza okunonyereza - Kino kiyinza okubaawo naye si kye kikulu ennyo mu mulimu guno.

**B.** Fumbekera ebibuuzo - Omusomesa ye yawadde omutindo (mateeka ga Hooke), si bayizi abafumbekera bibuuzo.

**C.** Nnyonnyola era olwanirire n'obukakafu - Kino kye kikulu! Abayizi bawandiika ebyo bye bazuula mu mmeeza, bateekateeka lipooti mu ngeri y'ekipande, era bakireetebwa eri bannaabwe. Kino kyolaga bulungi okunnyonnyola n'okulwanirira n'obukakafu mu bigambo ne mu buwandiike.

**D.** Teekateeka enteekateeka z'okunoonyereza - Omusomesa ye yateekateeka enkola, si bayizi.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **etteeka lya Ohm** era omusomesa ayagala abayizi **okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika**.

Etteeka lya Ohm liraga omukwano wakati wa:
- Voltisi (V)
- Amaanyi g'amasannyalaze/Current (I)  
- Obuzibu/Resistance (R)

Okusemberera okussaawo etteeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza, abayizi balina:
1. Okukuŋŋaanya ebipimo
2. Okulaba omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika
3. Okuzuula enkola/pattern
4. Okussaawo etteeka okuva ku bye balabye

**Ekyokulabirako A**: Abayizi bakola ggulaafu nga balaga current okusinziira ku voltisi nga resistance ya nkalakkalira - kino kiragisa bulungi omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika era kiyamba okuzuula etteeka.

**Ekyokulabirako B**: Bakola ggulaafu okuva mu mmeeza erimu ebipimo - kino nakyo kiragisa omukwano era kiyamba okuzuula enkola.

# Okwanukula Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku bintu abayizi bye beetaaga okumanya okusobola okunnyonnyola lwaki waliwo enjawulo mu ngeri eddoboozi gye livuga wakati w'ennyimba ze zimu ezikubiddwa ebivuga eby'enjawulo.

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu:

**A. Amaanyi n'eddoboozi** - Kino kikwata ku maanyi g'eddoboozi (volume) n'obulungi bw'eddoboozi, naye si kino ekikulu ekivaamu enjawulo wakati w'ebivuga eby'enjawulo.

**B. Endengo n'okugattika kw'amayengo** - Kino kikwata ku ndengo (pitch) n'okugatta kw'amayengo, naye si kino ekikulu ekivaamu enjawulo y'eddoboozi wakati w'ebivuga.

**C. Okukyama n'okudda kw'ekirekyerekyo ky'amaloboozi** - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okukyama n'okudda kw'amaloboozi, naye si kino ekikulu ekivaamu enjawulo y'eddoboozi.

**D. Omugatte gw'omuvumbo n'obuwanvu bw'ejjengo ly'amaloboozi** - Kino kye kikulu! Eddoboozi (timbre) liva ku mugatte gw'omuvumbo (frequency) n'obuwanvu bw'ejjengo ly'amaloboozi (wavelength). Kino kye kivaamu enjawulo wakati w'ebivuga eby'enjawulo ne bwe bikuba ennyimba y'emu.

**D**

Nkebera ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera obumanyirivu bw'abayizi mu kiruubirirwa kino: "Okuwa obunnyonnyofu ku bintu ebikwata ku masannyalaze agabeera mu kintu, gamba ng'engeri ebintu gye bikwatibwa amasannyalaze n'engeri amasannyalaze gye gafulumizibwa."

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw'abayizi ku:
- Ebintu ebikwata ku masannyalaze agabeera mu kintu (static electricity)
- Engeri ebintu gye bikwatibwa amasannyalaze
- Engeri amasannyalaze gye gafulumizibwa

Nkebera buli kirowoozo:

A. Kino kyogera ku masannyalaze okuyita mu bintu - kino kikwata ku "current electricity" si "static electricity"

B. Kino kyogera ku etteeka lya Coulomb n'amaanyi wakati w'obukakafu - kino kya ssaayansi ey'omulembe ogw'amaanyi nnyo

C. Kino kyogera ku by'obukuumi okuva mu bintu eby'amasannyalaze - kino kikwata ku nkozesa, naye si kukebera okutegeera kw'omusingi

D. Kino kyogera ku bintu ebiyisa amasannyalaze n'obuzibu bwabyo - kino nate kikwata ku "current electricity" (conductors and resistance)

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw'omusingi ku "static electricity" - engeri ebintu gye bikwatibwa amasannyalaze n'engeri gye gafulumizibwa.

C

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okuzuula omulimu oguyamba abayizi okukula mu bukugu bw'okutegeera **obunafu bw'ebipimo bya ssaayansi n'enzirugaanzi**.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Okupima embiro y'omubiri oguserera - kino kikwata ku kupima n'okugerageraanya, naye tekikwata nnyo ku kutegeera obunafu bw'ebipimo n'enzirugaanzi.

**B.** Okuzuula emisinde omubiri gwe gwaagwa nagwo - kino kikwata ku kupima n'okugerageraanya, naye tekikwata nnyo ku kutegeera obunafu bw'ebipimo.

**C.** Okugonomola ebizibu by'entambula ennyonjo eyanguyiziddwa nga bakozesa emiramwa gy'ekinenematiki n'enkolagana z'ekibalangulo, **oluvannyuma ogerageranye ebyavaamu n'endowooza zo ez'emabega** - Kino kisobozesa abayizi okulaba enjawulo wakati w'ebipimo ebituufu n'ebyo ebyali biteeberezebwa, ekiyamba okutegeera obunafu bw'ebipimo n'enzirugaanzi.

**D.** Okubalanguula obudde, obuwanvu n'omuvuyo nga bakozesa omusingi - kino kikwata ku kupima n'okugerageraanya.

Ekisobola okutegeera **obunafu bw'ebipimo n'enzirugaanzi** kye **C** kubanga kiragira ddala okugerageraanya ebipimo ebifuniddwa n'ebyo ebyali biteeberezebwa, ekiyamba abayizi okutegeera enjawulo n'obunafu mu bipimo.

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa awa abayizi omulimu gw'okukebera oguli mu mbeera bbiri ez'okutangaala okumasa ekkubo. Abasaba:
a) Okugeraageranya ekika ky'ekisiikirize ekinaava
b) Okunonyereza eky'okuddamu nga bakozesa omusingi gw'obutundutundu bw'ekitangaala ne jjomettuliya w'eby'amaso

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Bukugu ki obwa sayansi obusobola okukeberwa?

Nneekebera buli ky'okulondamu:

A. Okukiikirira amawulire - Kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza amawulire, naye omulimu guno gusaba okukola ennyinyonnyola ez'ekinnassaayansi.

B. Okunnyonnyola ebiva mu kunoonyereza - Kino kikwata ku kunnyonnyola ebiva, naye omulimu guno gusinga okusaba okukola ennyinyonnyola ez'ekinnassaayansi.

C. Nnyonnyola nga osinziira ku misingi n'ennyinyonnyola ez'ekinnassaayansi - Kino kye kituufu! Omulimu gusaba abayizi okunonyereza eky'okuddamu nga bakozesa omusingi gw'obutundutundu bw'ekitangaala ne jjomettuliya - kino kwe kukozesa ennyinyonnyola ez'ekinnassaayansi okunnyonnyola ebiva.

D. Ennono ezireetera engeri entondeka y'ebintu - Kino kikwata ku kubuulira, naye si kye kikulu mu mulimu guno.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **mulamwa gw'obukyayakya obw'enjawulo** mu mukolo gw'ekitundu **Ekyeya n'Obutemyevu**.

Nneeberereza buli ky'okulabirako:

**A.** Obutondo bw'amazzi ku kacupa - kino kikwata ku **condensation** (okufuuka amazzi okuva mu mpewo)

**B.** Tempulikya y'amazzi mu ntamu eteyeyongera - kino kikwata ku **boiling point** (ekipimo eky'okufumba) - amazzi gafumba ku 100°C era tempulikya esigala nga y'emu okutuusa amazzi lwe gaweddewo

**C.** Lumonde akyali wa bbugumu, ennyama esobola okuliibwa - kino kiraga nti **ebintu eby'enjawulo bikyayakya ku tempulikya ez'enjawulo** (different materials have different heat capacities/thermal properties)

**D.** Eccupa enzirugavu etuuka ku tempulikya ya waggulu - kino kikwata ku **langi n'okunywa omusana** (absorption of heat)

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **obukyayakya obw'enjawulo** - kitegeeza engeri ebintu eby'enjawulo gye bikyayakya mu ngeri ez'enjawulo.

Ekyanulo ekisinga okulaga bulungi omulamwa guno kwe **C** - lumonde n'ennyama bikyayakya mu ngeri ez'enjawulo newaakubadde nga byafumbiddwa wamu.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okusomesa okuva ku **kikulu okudda ku kitono** (from general to specific) mu butonde bwa polima.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Etandikira ku monoma (bitono/specific) → polima (binene) → ebyokulabirako
- Kino kiva ku kitono okudda ku kikulu

**B.** Etandikira ku ebyokulabirako bya polima (binene/general) → engeri gye zikolebwamu → monoma (bitono)
- Kino kiva ku kikulu okudda ku kitono ✓

**C.** Etandikira ku ebyokulabirako bya polima → okwawula obutundutundu → engeri gye zikolebwamu
- Kino nakyo kiva ku kikulu okudda ku kitono

**D.** Elaga ebyokulabirako n'ebizizimba (monoma) wamu → oluvannyuma banoonya polima endala
- Kino kilaga byombi wamu, si nkola ey'okuva ku kikulu okudda ku kitono

Ekirowoozo kya **pedagogical** ekisinga obulungi kwe kuva ku bintu abayizi bye bamanyi (polima mu bulamu obwa bulijjo - general/kikulu) okutuuka ku bintu ebitono (monoma - specific/kitono).

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku:
1. Empalirizo eziri mu atomu (atomic structure)
2. Enkyukakyuka z'enukiriya (nuclear reactions)
3. Okusattuluka kw'enukiriya (radioactive decay)
4. Ebika by'obusattuluzi (types of radiation) nga alufa, beta, ne gamma

Bino byonna bikwatagana n'**obusattuluzi bw'enukiriya** (radioactivity) n'**enkyukakyuka mu mutima gw'atomu** (nucleus).

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

A. Ensibika y'obusirikale bw'akaziba - Kino kikwatagana n'obusirikale/obuzito bwa kaziba, si ku busattuluzi

B. Ensibuko y'obutoffaali bw'ebintu - Kino kikwatagana n'obuzito/obunene bw'ebintu, si ku busattuluzi bw'enukiriya

C. Enkola y'obusengeke bw'amasannyalaze mu atomu - Kino kikwatagana n'**obusattuluzi bw'enukiriya** n'enkyukakyuka mu mutima gw'atomu, era kye kikwatagana n'ebika by'obusattuluzi (alufa, beta, gamma)

D. Endabika y'ebipimo by'obuzito bw'akaziba - Kino kikwatagana n'obuzito, si ku busattuluzi

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Abayizi bakola okunoonyereza ku **okunnyonnyola okubaawo kw'ekyuma mu emmunyeenye enkadde ennyo**.

Ekyuma (iron) mu emmunyeenye kikola nga:
- Emmunyeenye ennene bwe zikaddiwa, zikolamu **okwebulukuka kwa atomu** (nuclear fusion)
- Mu nkola eno, atomu entonotono zegatta okukola atomu ennene
- Ekyuma kye kintu ekisembayo ekivaamu mu nkola eno
- Emmunyeenye enkadde ennyo ze zisobola okukola ekyuma olw'okwebulukuka kwa atomu okw'amaanyi

Ebirowoozo ebirala:
- A (omukwano gw'enzatulo n'amasoboza) - tekikwatagana n'okukola ekyuma
- B (enkyukakyuka mu buziizi) - si kino ekikulu
- C (okutabika kw'obuziizi) - tekinyonnyola okukola ekyuma

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza kintu ki omuyizi ky'alina okumanya okusobola **okukola** ku musingi gwa VSEPR mu molekyu ez'enjawulo.

VSEPR (Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion) ye theory ekozesebwa okulaga enkola y'obuziba bwa molekyu okusinziira ku kuwangula kw'ebipapula by'elektrooni mu valence shell.

Okusobola okukola ku musingi gwa VSEPR, omuyizi alina okumanya:
- Omuwendo gw'ebipapula by'elektrooni ebiri mu valence shell
- Engeri ebipapula bino gye bisaasaanira okwewala (repulsion)
- Enkola y'obuziba ezivaamu

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Dipole moments - kino kijja oluvannyuma w'okuzuula enkola
B. **Duet ne octet rules** - Bino bikulu nnyo okumanya omuwendo gw'elektrooni mu valence shell, nga kye kintu ekisooka mu kukola VSEPR
C. Empandiika za kemiko - ziyamba naye si kye kintu ekikulu
D. Akakodyo ka VSEPR - kino kye theory yennyini naye si "kintu ky'okumanya" okukola

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okunnyonnyola engeri pH gy'ekolamu mu kwetoloolesa asidi ow'amaanyi n'ekintu ekirina obunafu obutono."

Kino kye kigendererwa ekikwata ku **titration** - omukolo gw'okugera obungi bw'asidi oba base nga tukozesa ekintu ekimanyiddwa obungi bwakyo.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

B. Okukebera asidi ow'amaanyi nga bakozesa ebintu eby'obusirikale - kino si kituufu era tekikwatagana n'ekigendererwa

C. Okugera omuwendo gw'obungi bw'ekyokulwanyisa... ku pKb - kino kikwata ku calculations, si practical observation ey'engeri pH bw'ekyukakyuka

D. **Okugenderera okumanya obungi bw'asidi ennywevu nga basinziira ku bungi obumanyiddwa bw'ekireevu ekinafu** - Kino kye kituufu! Mu titration, tukozesa base (ekireevu) ey'obungi obumanyiddwa okugera obungi bw'asidi, era mu nkola eno tulaba engeri pH bw'ekyukakyuka (practical observation).

Ekigendererwa kye "okunnyonnyola n'okulaga engeri empalirizo eziyitibwa ionic ne covalent bonds gye zikoleka."

Kino kitegeeza abayizi balina:
1. Okunnyonnyola (okwogera/okuwandiika) engeri bonds bwe zikoleka
2. Okulaga (demonstrate/show) engeri bonds bwe zikoleka

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Okulaga ekifananyi kya Lewis n'okubala amasannyalaze - kino kikolera ku "okulaga" naye tekikwata ku "okunnyonnyola engeri gye zikoleka"

B. Okubuuza oba bagenda kukolerera duet oba octet - kino kikwata ku rules naye si ku "okunnyonnyola n'okulaga engeri bonds bwe zikoleka"

C. **Okukola molekyu bbiri, buli emu nga erimu ekika ky'obubonero obubiri obw'enkolagana** - kino kisobozesa abayizi okulaga ionic bond (emu) ne covalent bond (endala) era basobola okunnyonnyola engeri buli emu gye yikoleka

D. Okumanya ekika ky'emikwatane - kino kikwata ku prediction naye si ku "okunnyonnyola n'okulaga engeri gye zikoleka"

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino n'obwegendereza:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kabonero: "Kozesa omulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu ekimusaanuusa."

Omulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu (density) gwe mugatte gw'obuzito bw'ekintu n'obunene bwakyo. Ekimusaanuusa kitegeeza ekintu ekigattululwa mu mazzi.

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

A. Kino kyogera ku "kika ky'ekitangala" - si kigendererwa kikulu ku mulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu.

B. Kino kyogera ku kugattulula ebintu eby'enjawulo mu buziba bw'amazzi obutakyuka era okubiteeka mu mutindo ogweyongera okusinziira ku mutindo gw'ekintu ekyegattuluddwa. Kino kikwatagana n'omulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu kubanga ebintu ebigattululwa amazzi ag'enjawulo birina omulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu ogw'enjawulo.

C. Kino kyogera ku "kika ky'obuziba" ku tempulikya ez'enjawulo - si kigendererwa kikulu ku mulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu.

D. Kino kyogera ku byazalula eby'enjawulo - si kigendererwa kikulu ku mulamwa gw'obungi bw'ebiri mu kintu.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Mu kataffaali ka Downs, omunnyo gwa sodiyamu kkalolayidi (NaCl) guyabuluzibwa. Mu nkola eno:

**Ku cathode (negative electrode):**
- Ayoni za sodiyamu (Na⁺) zikendeezebwa (reduction)
- Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na
- Sodiyamu ey'ekyuma efulumizibwa wano

**Ku anode (positive electrode):**
- Ayoni za kkalolayidi (Cl⁻) zioksidizibwa (oxidation)
- 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻
- Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa wano

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. **Sikyatuufu** - Sodiyamu eterekebwa ku cathode (si anode), era ayoni za sodiyamu zikendeezebwa (si ku anode)

B. **Sikyatuufu** - Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa ku anode (si cathode)

C. **Kituufu** - Ayoni za kkalolayidi zigenda ku anode era zioksidizibwa

D. **Sikyatuufu** - Sodiyamu efulumizibwa ku cathode (si okutambula okudda)

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino ng'ogoberera enkola ey'okunoonyereza ku ssaayansi:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga ensonga entuufu ey'ekisaayansi ku mukwano wakati w'ebirungo ebiwoomerera n'obulamu bw'omuntu (kookolo).

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

**A. Saccharin aleeta kookolo w'ensigo, nga waliwo okunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku mpuku okwalaga kino.**
- Kino kya ssaayansi kubanga kiyogera ku kunoonyereza okwakolebwa (evidence-based)
- Kyogera ku mpuku (animal studies) - enkola ya ssaayansi

**B. Ebirungo ebisaasaanya obulungi birimu obutoffaali obulina akabi...**
- Kino kya ssaayansi naye tekituufu - chlorine si nsonga ya kookolo

- Kino kya correlation naye si causation - okweyongera kw'abantu abali ne kookolo mu 1973 tekikakasa nti aspartame ye nsonga

**D. Ebibiina ebikuumira eby'obulamu mu Amerika bigambye...**
- Kino si nsonga ya ssaayansi - kya political/organizational statement

Ekiyanulo ekituufu kya ssaayansi ekiyimirira ku evidence:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kunoonyereza okukwata ku bintu bya carbonyl (formaldehyde ne acetone) nga bakozesa Tollens' reagent ne chromic acid.

Ebimanyiddwa mu ssaayansi:

1. **Tollens' reagent**: Ekikozesebwa kino kikkiriza **aldehydes zokka** (si ketones). Aldehydes zivaamu silver mirror.

2. **Chromic acid**: Ekikozesebwa kino kikkiriza **aldehydes ne alcohols** (si ketones). Ketones tezikyusibwa chromic acid.

Mu kunoonyereza:
- Formaldehyde = aldehyde
- Acetone = ketone

Ebisuubirwa:
- Tollens' reagent ejja kukola ku formaldehyde (aldehyde) yokka
- Chromic acid ejja kukola ku formaldehyde (aldehyde) yokka

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

A. Asidi ya kromiki ekkiriza ketone zokka - **KIKYAMU** (chromic acid tekikola ku ketones)

B. Ekikozesebwa kya Tollens kikkiriza okumanya obulungi ebibala bya aldehyde byokka - **KITUUFU** (Tollens' reagent kikola ku aldehydes zokka)

C. Asidi ya kromiki esobozesa okutegeera ekikwatagana kyonna ekya kabonayiro - **KIKYAMU** (tekikola ku ketones)

D. Ekikozesebwa kya Tollens kisobozesa okutegeera ekigatte kyonna ekya carbonyl - **KIKYAMU** (tekikola ku ketones)

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa agenda kutandika okukola ku kigendererwa kya **"okwetegereza n'okunnyonnyola enkyukakyuka ezibaawo mu bintu ng'omuntu akozesa amaanyi, ekitangaala, ebbugumu, n'amazzi."**

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza: Musomo ki omusomesa gw'asaanye **okusooka** okukolako nga tannaba kwogera ku kigendererwa kino?

D. Kulaga ekisiikirizo eky'okugeraageranya - kino nakyo kirungi naye si "butereevu" nga okulaga omulimu gw'ennyini

- Ebyo bye byawonawona

Ka ntunuulire buli kintu:

1. **Okusala amagulu (Crossing-over)** - Nkola entongole mu kukyusakyusa DNA

3. **Entabaganyi n'okweyawulamu kw'obutoffaali** - Enkola empanvu ey'okweyawulamu
4. **Enteekateeka y'ebintu by'obutonde mu butoffaali** - Enkola ey'awamu, ekikulu ennyo

Okuva ku kikulu okudda ku kitono:
- **Kikulu ennyo**: Enteekateeka y'ebintu by'obutonde (4) - general concept
- **Ekirala**: Entabaganyi n'okweyawulamu (3) - broader process
- **Ekirala**: Ebifo we wabaawo okweyawulamu (5) - specific locations
- **Entongole**: Okusala amagulu (1) - specific mechanism

4. Abayizi bawandiika bye balabye

Obunafu buli mu step 6 - abayizi baweereddwa obudde okukola "okunnyonnyola okukkiriziganyiziddwaako" naye tebaakwataganyizibwa na birumirwa ebyayita (step 2) oba concept entuufu y'amasannyalaze.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa yateekawo ekibalangulo: x = 25 + 40t - 5t²

Abayizi baddamu:
- Ku t=5s: omubiri gutambudde mita 100
- Ku t=6s: omubiri gutambudde mita 85

Leka nkebere ekituufu:

Ku t=5s: x(5) = 25 + 40(5) - 5(5)² = 25 + 200 - 125 = 100 mita
Ku t=6s: x(6) = 25 + 40(6) - 5(6)² = 25 + 240 - 180 = 85 mita

Abayizi baakola obubala obulungi! Naye omusomesa agamba nti "tebakimanyi nti omubiri gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu."

Ekibuuzo kyabuuza obuwanvu omubiri bwe gutambudde **okuva ku 5s okutuuka ku 6s** (mu kiseera kya sikonda 1).

Obuwanvu obutambuliddwa = x(6) - x(5) = 85 - 100 = -15 mita

Kino kitegeeza omubiri gweddiza emabega mita 15, si kutambula mu maaso mita 100 oba 85.

Ekizibu kya abayizi: **tebategeera nti x(t) ye position (ekifo), so obuwanvu obutambuliddwa bwe displacement (enkyukakyuka mu kifo)** - si position value yokka.

Kino kya **obutabaawo kw'etendeka mu kumanya ebintu ebirambiddwa** (position vs displacement) **n'okukozesa ennyingo ezisaana** (okuggyako, si kusoma values zokka).

1. **Okwetegereza/Okupima** (observing/measuring) - ebya bulijjo
2. **Okugeraageranya** (comparing) - okwongera okwetegereza
3. **Okubala/Okugereranya** (calculating/quantifying) - okwongera okukala
4. **Okutegeera enkolagana** (understanding relationships) - ebikalu ennyo

Nga ntunuulira ebikolwa ebiweereddwa:
1. Okubala ebbugumu - **okugereranya/okubala** (quantifying)
2. Okupima n'okugeraageranya obwoki - **okwetegereza n'okugeraageranya** (observing & comparing)
3. Okutegeera olukalo lw'ebbugumu - **okutegeera enkolagana** (understanding relationships)
4. Okubala obusobozi - **okugereranya/okubala** (quantifying ability)

Olubu omulamwa ogutuufu:

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukebera obusobozi bw'abayizi **okutegeka ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi** okugenderera okumanya ebintu ebyeyambisibwa okuleetera ekintu okubuguma.

Ekibuuzo ky'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi kirina okubeera:
- Ekibuuzo ekiyinza okugezesebwa
- Ekirina enkyukakyuka eziyinza okukebererwa
- Ekisobola okuddibwamu nga tukozesa okunoonyereza

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulonda:

**A.** Bakola okunoonyereza okuteekawo ebintu... - Kino kikwata ku **kuteekawo** okunoonyereza, si kutegeka ekibuuzo

**B.** Bakunganya ebipimo... nebamaliriza kubintu ebireetera... - Kino kikwata ku **kukunganya data n'okumaliriza**, si kutegeka ekibuuzo

**C.** Bakozesa obukakafu... nga bakozesa amagezi... - Kino kikwata ku **kukozesa data okuzimba ensonga**, si kutegeka ekibuuzo

**D.** Bakola ekirowoozo ekikeberebwa ekikwataganya okubuuka kw'ebintu ku nkyukakyuka ez'enjawulo... nga bassaawo enkolagana entuufu - Kino kiraga **okutegeka ekibuuzo** nga balambulula enkyukakyuka (enkula, obukwafuwavu, obungi) eziyinza okukebererwa

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okulaga nti okumanya mu kemisitule:
- kukulakulana (kwakyukakyuka)
- kwa maanyi 
- kujjudde empaka (kwali na mpaka/enkulaakulana)

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

A. Empaka z'ebiteeso by'enzimbulukusa y'akaziba - Kino kiragisa empaka ez'ebyafaayo, ekiraga nti okumanya kwakyukakyuka era kwali na mpaka.

B. Teekawo lipoota y'okunoonyereza ku musingi gwa VSEPR - Kino kya teknika/ssaayansi ey'oluwummula, si byafaayo by'empaka.

C. Empaka z'okulaga amateeka g'ebinyonyi - Kino kya ssaayansi ey'obulamu, naye si nnyo ku kwegatta kw'ebintu (kemisitule).

D. Nnongeza y'ebivuddeko eby'ebyafaayo by'endowooza y'okwegatta - Kino kiragisa ebyafaayo by'engeri abantu gye baategeera okwegatta kw'ebintu, ekiraga enkulaakulana n'empaka mu kumanya.

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku "okwegatta kw'ebintu" (kemisitule) era "okumanya kukulakulana, kwa maanyi era kujjudde empaka."

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Abayizi balowooza nti emmunnyu zombi (NaCl ne NaHCO3) zisaanuuka mu mazzi mu ngeri y'emu. Naye oluvannyuma lw'ekiigezo, bazuula nti tezirina busaanuufu bwe bumu.

Enkyamu y'abayizi eri mu kulowooza nti:
- Emmunnyu zombi zivaamu ayoni 2 (Na+ n'ayoni endala)
- Kale zirina okuba n'obusaanuufu obwe bumu

Naye amazima ge gali nti:
- Obusaanuufu bw'emmunnyu mu mazzi tebusinziira ku muwendo gwa ayoni zokka
- Businziira ku **nkola** - engeri atomu/molekyu gye zikolamu omukago n'ekinyunguluzi (amazzi)
- Cl− ne HCO3− zirina obukulu n'ensengeka ez'enjawulo, kale zikolagana n'amazzi mu ngeri ez'enjawulo
- Kino kikosa obusaanuufu okuba obw'enjawulo

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku **birowoozo ebikyamu** (misconceptions) abayizi bye baba nabyo ku **bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi** (non-spontaneous processes) mu thermodynamics.

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A. Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.**
- Kino kikyamu kubanga mu bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi, entropy y'ensi yonna eyinza okukendeera (okugwa), naye kino kyetaaga amasoboza okuva ebweru. Abayizi batera okufuuka n'ekikyamu nti entropy bulijjo yeyongera, naye kino kikakasa bikolwa ebyetereera byokka.

**B. Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.**
- Kino si kirowoozo kikyamu kikulu ku bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi.

**C. Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.**
- Kino kyogera ku sipiidi, si ku bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi.

**D. Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n'okusaasaanya amasoboza.**
- Kino si kikyamu - mu mazima ebintu ebyetereera (spontaneous) byesigama ku kusaasaanya amasoboza n'okweyongera kwa entropy.

Ekikyamu ekisinga okubaawo kwe kuba abayizi okulowoza nti entropy bulijjo yeyongera ne mu bikolwa ebitakozesebwa maanyi mangi, nga tebategeera nti ebyo byetaaga amasoboza okuva ebweru.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **etteeka lya Hund** erikwata ku **bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo** (maximum multiplicity).

Etteeka lya Hund ligamba nti: Mu orbital ez'amaanyi agenkana, elekitulooni zijjuza buli orbital nga zirina spin emu nga zitannakozesa bbiri mu orbital emu.

Kino kitegeeza nti elekitulooni zisaasaana mu orbital ez'amaanyi agenkana (nga p, d, f orbitals) nga zirina spin ez'emu okusooka, okusobola okufuna **obusannyalaze obusinga obungi** (maximum number of unpaired electrons).

Nnekennenya ebyokuddamu:

A. Endagiriro z'obusannyalaza ez'ensi yonna - Kino kiyinza okulaga obusannyalaze naye si kigendererwa kikulu kya Hund's rule.

B. Empandiika ya elekitulooni - Kino kiyinza okulaga okuteekebwa kw'elekitulooni naye si kya bulijjo.

C. **Okugeraageranya okusaasaanya kw'obusannyalaza mu dayagulaamu z'obusa** - Kino kye kituufu ddala! Dayagulaamu z'obusa (orbital diagrams) zilaga engeri elekitulooni gye zisaasaanyizibwa mu orbital ez'enjawulo n'obusannyalaze bwazo, ekyo kye kikulu mu kulaga Hund's rule.

D. Endabika y'amasannyalaze ag'ebweru - Kino kikwata ku valence electrons naye si kigendererwa kikulu kya Hund's rule.

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino mu ngeri ey'omutendera:

**Emirimu gy'abayizi:**
- Okwongera ebintu eby'enjawulo (omunnyo, essukaali, bicarbonate, amafuta, omwenge) mu mazzi
- Okunnyonnyola lwaki ebimu bisaanuuka ddala, ebirala bitundu, ate ebirala tebisaanuuka

**Ekigendererwa ekikwatagana:**

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Gerageranya obusobozesi bw'ebintu ebya polaa ne bitari bya polaa okusaanuuka - Kino kikwatagana nnyo kubanga amazzi ga polaa, omunnyo/essukaali/bicarbonate bya polaa (bisaanuuka), amafuta/omwenge bitali bya polaa nnyo (tebisaanuuka bulungi)

**B.** Enneeyisa y'ebintu nga bimyuse - Omulimu tegukwata ku kumyusa bintu

**C.** Enkolagana z'amaanyi aga molekyu - Kino kya ssaayansi nnyingi nnyo eri abayizi ba siniya omwaka ogusooka

**D.** Kwataganya obuziba n'okusobola okusaanuuka - Omulimu tegukwata ku buziba bw'ebintu

Ekibuuzo kikwata ku nkola ya "polarity" (ebya polaa ne bitali bya polaa) mu kusaanuuka - ekigendererwa ekikulu mu kuyiga okusaanuuka.

**A**

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekigendererwa: Okuyamba abayizi okutegeera enjawulo mu mitendera gy'enkolagana wakati wa molekyu era n'okukulaakulanya obukugu mu bya ssaayansi.

Nneekenneenya buli kikolwa:

- Kino kikwata ku nkola z'omunda, si ku mitendera gy'enkolagana wakati w'obuziba

**B. Okukola maapu y'endowooza nga basinziira ku kusoma**
- Kino kikwata ku kusoma n'okutegeerera, naye si kukola mu bya ssaayansi oba okugezesa

**C. Okwekenneenya obubaawo bw'enkolagana wakati w'ebintu ebiri mu molekyu**
- Kino kikwata ku kuzuula enkolagana wakati w'obuziba mu bintu ebyobutonde
- Kiyamba abayizi okukola mu bya ssaayansi nga bakola okunoonyereza

**D. Okukola enteekateeka y'okugezesa okuzuula obukakafu**
- Kino kikwata ku kukola enteekateeka yokka, si kukola okugezesa kwennyini
- Tekituukiriza nnyo okukulaakulanya obukugu mu bya ssaayansi

Nga twetegereza enkola y'ebibuuzo ebisooka (ebiyita mu kukola okw'amaanyi n'okugezesa), ekikolwa ekisinga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kya **C** - kubanga kiyamba abayizi okukola okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi mu bintu ebyobutonde.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi okutegeera nti ensolo ezimu zifaanagana mu ndabika, ekizisobozesa okuteekebwa mu kibinja kye kimu.

Ekikulu wano kwe **kwawula** (classify/categorize) ensolo okusinziira ku **ndabika ezifaanagana**.

Ka ntunuulire buli kikolwa:

A. Lambulula empisa ezirabika - Kino kikwata ku kulambulula, si kwawula mu bibinja
B. Gattika ebifaananyi by'ensolo okusinziira ku kika ky'ekibikka omubiri gwazo - Kino kikwata ku **kwawula** ensolo mu bibinja okusinziira ku **ndabika ezifaanagana** (ekibikka omubiri)
C. Loba ensolo okusinziira ku birungo ebiweereddwa - Kino si kwawula okusinziira ku ndabika ezifaanagana, wabula ku birungo ebiweereddwa
D. Lagaanye ensolo n'ekifo we zibeera - Kino kikwata ku matching, si kwawula mu bibinja

Ekikolwa ekituukiriza ekigendererwa ky'okwawula ensolo okusinziira ku ndabika ezifaanagana kiri:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kunoonyereza okw'okugezesa okukwata ku byetaago by'ebimera (amazzi). Abayizi basiga ensigo mu mabeki 3, era **ekintu ekikyuka** (variable) kye **omuwendo gw'amazzi** - bbeki 1 efuna amazzi omulundi gumu buli lunaku, bbeki 2 omulundi gumu buli wiiki, ne bbeki 3 emirundi ebiri buli wiiki.

Ekibuuzo kibuuza: Kiki ekiraga nti abayizi basobole okufuna ennamalirizo ezikwatagana n'okugezesa kwe bakoze okusinziira ku **kintu ekikyuka**?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okuddamu:

A. Banuunula omusana n'ebimera by'omu mazzi - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka (amazzi)

B. Balaga ebiriisa amazzi bye gawa ebimera okukula - Kino kikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka (omuwendo gw'amazzi) era kiraga engeri amazzi ag'enjawulo gye gakosa okukula

C. Bye basalawo omuwendo gw'amazzi ekimera kye kyetaaga okukula - Kino kya "okusalawo" si "ennamalirizo" okuva mu kugezesa

D. Banannyonnyola omulimu gw'emirandira - Kino tekikwatagana n'ekintu ekikyuka

**B**

Nze nja kunoonyereza ku kibuuzo kino n'obwegendereza.

Mu mbeera eno, omusomesa:
1. Asaba abaana okusooka okusiiga ekifaananyi kye balowooza nti kigenda okubaawo
2. Bakola okunoonyereza (okuteeka akakunkumuka k'omuzira ku musana)
3. Basiiga ekifaananyi eky'ekyo kye balabye ddala
4. Bageraageranya ebifaananyi ebibiri (ekyo kye baalowooza n'ekyo kye balabye)
5. Bannyonnyola engeri gye bifaanagana era gye byawukanira
6. Balaba oba ekyo kye baalowooza kyabaddewo ddala

Ekikulu wano kwe **kugeraageranya** - okwetegereza enjawulo n'okufaanagana wakati w'ekyo kye baalowooza (prediction) n'ekyo kye balabye mu kunoonyereza (observation). Kino kye kikulu nnyo mu nkola ya ssaayansi - okugeraageranya ebirowoozo n'ebiva mu kunoonyereza.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kutegeera engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu okuva ku kintu ekimu okudda ku kirala. Abayizi baalina okutegeera nti engoye enzigumu zikuuma obugumu kubanga zikendeeza omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu.

Nnekalakasa buli kikolwa:

**A.** Okukwata ebintu eby'enjawulo (ekibaawo, ekyuma, ekidomola) n'okuwandiika obunnyogovu/ebbugumu - Kino kiyamba okutegeera nti ebintu eby'enjawulo birina obutonde bw'ebbugumu obwenjawulo, naye tekiyolesa bulungi engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu.

**B.** Ebikopo bibiri eby'amazzi ebirina tempulikya ez'enjawulo, ekimu nga kibikkiddwa ssoosi y'ebyoya - Kino KIRAGISA ddala omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu wakati w'ebintu bibiri era kiragisa engeri ebyoya (ng'engoye enzigumu) bwe bikendeeza omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu. Kino kikwatagana nnyo n'okutegeera lwaki engoye enzigumu zikuuma obugumu.

**C.** Ebikopo bisatu mu mbeera ez'enjawulo (mu musana, okumpi n'ekyokero, okumpi n'amazzi ag'obugumu) - Kino kiyamba okutegeera enkyukakyuka y'ebbugumu naye tekiyolesa bulungi omuyitiro gw'ebbugumu.

**D.** Akakwaso aka kyuma n'aka aliminyamu ku muliro - Kino kiyamba okutegeera nti ebintu eby'enjawulo bitwala ebbugumu mu ngeri ez'enjawulo, naye tekiyolesa bulungi omuyitiro.

Ekikolwa **B** kye kisinga okuyamba abayizi okutegeera engeri ebbugumu gye liyitamu era lwaki engoye enzigumu zikuuma obugumu.

**B**

# Nkola y'Okusalawo

Kino kye kibuuzo ekikwata ku ngeri omusomesa gy'ayinza okuddamu ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi mu ngeri ey'obwesimbu bwa ssaayansi era nga akozesa olulimi olugwanira abaana b'ekibiina ky'omunaana.

Ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi: "Kiki ekibaawo ku bimera bwe biba tebifukirirwa ne bikala?"

Nga nkebera buli kiyanulo:

**A** - Kino kikozesa ebigambo ebya ssaayansi ennyo nga "plasmolysis" ate era tekinyonnyola bulungi ensonga y'amazzi okugenda.

**B** - Kino kikyamu mu ssaayansi - kigamba nti emmunnyu egenda okuva munda okudda ebweru, naye mu mazima amazzi ge gagenda.

**C** - Kino nakyo kikyamu mu ssaayansi - kigamba nti amazzi gava ebweru okudda munda, naye mu mazzi aganywevu (hypertonic), amazzi gava munda okudda ebweru.

**D** - Kino kituufu mu ssaayansi era kikozesa olulimi olwangu olutegeekeka:
- Kinyonnyola bulungi nti amazzi gava munda okudda ebweru
- Kinyonnyola nti kino kireetera obutaffaali okukendeera
- Kinyonnyola ekivaamu (amakoola agootedde)
- Tekikozesa bigambo bya ssaayansi ebizibu nnyo

**D**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino ekikwata ku kiruubirirwa eky'okuyiga enkola y'okugemebwa ekolebwa eddagala erigema.

Okusobola okutegeera enkola y'okugemebwa ekolebwa eddagala erigema, abayizi balina okusooka okutegeera obwewomi obw'omuzaaliranwa (acquired immunity) kubanga eddagala erigema likola ku nkola eno. Eddagala erigema liyingiza obwewomi obw'omuzaaliranwa mu mubiri nga liyisa akawuka akafu oba akanafu, era omubiri ne gukola antibodies ezigema akawuka ako. Bwe kaba kajja nate, omubiri guba gumaze okuba n'obwewomi.

Ebirowoozo ebirala:
- A (obuzibu bw'omubiri) - kino tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkola y'eddagala erigema
- C (T lymphocytes) - wadde nga bino bikulu, si kye kimu ekisooka ekikulu okutegeera enkola y'eddagala erigema

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **etteeka lya Boyle** era ekigendererwa kye "Okunnyonnyola enneyisa y'ebinyonyi mu bukwatane n'etteeka lya Boyle."

## Etteeka lya Boyle

Etteeka lya Boyle lyogera ku nkolagana wakati wa **puleesa** (pressure) ne **voluumu** (volume) ya ggaasi nga **obugumu** (temperature) bukyali bumu.

## Ebintu Ebeetaagisa Okumanyibwa Okusooka

Okusobola okutegeera etteeka lya Boyle, omuyizi alina okumanya:
- Ggaasi ye bintu (matter)
- Enneyisa ya ggaasi (gas behavior)
- Engeri ggaasi gy'ekola ku mutindo gwa **molecular level**
- Omulamwa **kinetic-molecular** ogunnyonnyola engeri obusumuluzo bwa molecules bwe bukwatagana ne puleesa ne voluumu

## Okwekenneenya Ebyokuddamu

- **A**: Ebintu ebikulu - kino kya wansi nnyo
- **B**: Amasoboza - kino tekikwatagana butereevu
- **C**: Obusirikale - kino tekikwatagana
- **D**: Omulamwa gwa kinetic-molecular - kino kye kinnyonnyola enneyisa ya ggaasi era kye kiseeso kya Boyle's Law

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw'abayizi ku "mukwano oguteereddwawo wakati w'ebintu ebikyuka mu mateeka ga Boyle."

Amateeka ga Boyle gannyonnyola omukwano wakati wa pressure (puleesa) ne volume (obunene) bwa ggaasi nga temperature (ebbugumu) bwe liba tterevu: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye nti abayizi balage **engeri enkyukakyuka ezibaawo mu busirikale bw'obuziba obwa leediyoaktifu gye zikwatagana n'obugumu bwabwo**.

Kino kitegeeza nti abayizi balina okulaga enkolagana wakati w'ekiseera (obugumu bw'obuziba) n'enkyukakyuka mu busirikale bw'obusannyalaze.

Nneekebera buli kikolwa:

**A.** Okukiikirira ebifulumizibwa mu nkulukuta - kino kiyamba okutegeera ebifulumizibwa naye tekikwataganya bulungi obugumu n'enkyukakyuka mu busirikale.

**B.** Okutegeera ekika ky'ekifulumizibwa nga basinziira ku ggulaafu y'omusipi gw'obunywevu - **Ggulaafu y'omusipi gw'obunywevu** (decay curve) elaga engeri busirikale bwe bukendeera okweyongerayo ekiseera. Kino kiyamba nnyo okulaga enkolagana wakati w'obugumu (half-life) n'enkyukakyuka mu busirikale.

**C.** Okunoonyereza ku maanyi agasindiikiriza n'agaleeta - kino kikwatagana n'obutebenkevu bw'obusibe naye si ku nkyukakyuka mu busirikale okweyongerayo ekiseera.

**D.** Okuteekateeka akatonnyeze - kino kiyinza okuyamba naye tekituufu buli ekigendererwa nga B.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **kibalangulo** ekikwata ku **bungi bw'ebintu** (quantity) mu **budde** (time) mu kikolwa ky'obuziizi.

Omusomesa alabye nti abayizi **basoma bubi ekibalangulo** - kino kitegeeza nti tebasobola kutegeera engeri ekibalangulo gy'ekiikirira **enkyukakyuka** (changes) mu bungi bw'ebintu.

Ebibuuzo ebiyamba okutegeera ekibalangulo birina:
- Okwogera ku **enkyukakyuka** mu budde
- Okukwata ku **bungi** obw'ebintu
- Okuyamba abasomi ba kibalangulo okutegeera engeri ebintu gye bikyukakyuka

Nnekennenya buli kibuuzo:

**A** - Kyogera ku "ntandikwa" yokka - tekikwata ku nkyukakyuka

**B** - Kyogera ku "ntandikwa" yokka - tekikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu budde

**C** - Kyogera ku "ddi" (when) ebintu birekera - kino kikwata ku **budde** n'enkyukakyuka

**D** - Kyogera ku "okweyongerayo" - kino kikwata ku **nkyukakyuka mu bungi** mu budde

Ekibuuzo **D** kisinga okuyamba okutegeera ekibalangulo kubanga:
- Kibuuza ku **nkyukakyuka** (increase/change)
- Kikwata ku **bungi** bw'ebintu
- Kiyamba okutegeera engeri ekibalangulo gy'ekiikirira enkyukakyuka

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa alina ekizibu: abayizi bazimba olukoloboze lw'ekigeranyo ky'okugattika asidi n'ebbesi, naye bafuna omuwendo gwa pH omubi oluvannyuma lw'ekifo eky'obwenkanyi.

Ekigendererwa: okuyamba abayizi okumaliriza okuzimba olukoloboze olulungi.

Ka nnekennenya buli ky'okulondamu:

A. Kutwala abayizi mu labolatoli - Kino tekiyamba nnyo kubanga baali bamaze okukola ekigeranyo, ekizibu kiri mu kutegeera enkola.

B. Okunnyonnyola nti pH kipimo kya pozitiivu ogw'obungi bw'asidi oba bbeesi - Kino kiyamba okutegeera empapula, naye tekiyanjula ddala ekizibu ky'okuzimba olukoloboze.

C. Okunnyonnyola, nga nkuwa eky'okulabirako, bw'osobola okumanya omuwendo gw'obuziba obusukkulumu (excess moles) mu bitundu eby'enjawulo mu kiseera ky'okukebera - Kino kiyamba nnyo! Ekizibu kyabwe kiri mu kutegeera nti oluvannyuma lw'ekifo eky'obwenkanyi, waliwo ekintu ekisigalawo (excess), era kino kye kikosa pH. Eky'okulabirako kiyamba okutegeereza.

D. Okukozesa pulogulaamu kompyuta - Kino kiyinza okuyamba, naye tekiyigiriza abayizi kutegeera enkola.

Ekyanulo ekisinga obulungi kye **C** kubanga kiyigiriza abayizi okutegeera lwaki bafuna omuwendo gwa pH omubi oluvannyuma lw'ekifo eky'obwenkanyi - kubanga tebaali bakozesa bulungi omuwendo gw'ebintu ebisigalawo.

**C**

Nsomooza ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa alina ekizibu nti abayizi tebaategeera bulungi nti mu nkola za kemiko, obungi bw'ebintu ebikolawo n'ebivaamu bubeera bwe bumu (etteeka ly'okukuumibwa kw'obungi/obutebenkevu).

Ekibuuzo abayizi kye babuuza: "Ebintu ebikolawo n'ebivaamu bituuka ku butebenkevu byokka byokka?"

Nneekenneenya buli kyanulo:

**A.** Laga omuwendo gw'ekikolwa bwe kigenda... - Kino kiyinza okuyamba naye tekissa maanyi ku kutegeera nti obungi bubeera bwe bumu.

**B.** Laga ebyo ebiriwo ku mutendera ogw'obunene n'obutono... - Kino kiyogera ku mitindo gy'ebintu, si ku kutegeera etteeka ly'okukuumibwa kw'obungi.

**C.** Kola enkola y'okugezesa eraga engeri ebintu ebiyinza okutaataganya embeera y'obutaggwaawo... - Kino kiyogera ku kutaataganya, si ku kutegeera etteeka.

**D.** Kola enkola y'okugezesa ekusobozesa okubala obungi bw'ebintu ebiri mu kikulukusi nga tebikyuka okusinziira ku bungi bwabyo bwe byatandise nabyo - Kino kiragisa ddala etteeka ly'okukuumibwa kw'obungi/obutebenkevu mu nkola za kemiko - nti obungi bwa bintu ebikolawo bubeera bwe bumu n'obw'ebivaamu.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa akola omukolo gw'okugezesa ebbugumu n'enkyukakyuka zaakyo. Akozesa:

- Gilaasi erimu amazzi agabidde
- Obudde: 20°C
- Ekiseera: eddakiika 60

Abayizi bagamba nti bbaafu teerisaanuuke n'amazzi agabidde teganaannyogoga.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga: Kibuuzo ki ekinaasobozesa abayizi okuddamu okulowooza ku kirowoozo kyabwe?

Nnekennenya buli ky'okuddamu:

**A. Obubonero bw'obudde bukosa butya enkola y'entegeka?**
- Kino kiyinza okuyamba naye si kya musingi nnyo ku mbeera eno.

**B. Obupimiro bw'ebbugumu bukwatagana butya n'enkola enteekateeka?**
- Kino kituufu! Abayizi bagamba nti bbaafu teerisaanuuke (si kya mazima - bbaafu lisaanuuka) n'amazzi agabidde teganaannyogoga (si kya mazima - amazzi agabidde ganaannyogoga). Ekibuuzo kino kinaabasobozesa okutegeera nti ebbugumu ly'ebintu (bbaafu n'amazzi agabidde) ne ly'obudde (20°C) bikwatagana n'enkyukakyuka (okusaanuuka n'okwannyogoga).

**C. Lwaki emirundi mingi twogera ku bintu ebyokya n'ebinyogoga...**
- Kino kiyinza okuba kya mugaso naye si kya musingi ku mbeera eno.

**D. Enjawulo eri wakati w'obwoki bw'embeera n'obwoki bw'ebintu...**
- Kino kiyinza okuba kya mugaso naye si kye kibuuzo ekisinga obulungi okuddamu okulowooza.

- **B. Omulamwa gw'obutomera** - Kino kikwata ku butomera/density, si ku mbiro z'enkyukakyuka

Omulimu oguweebwa abayizi guzingiramu:

Ekigendererwa ekikulu kye **okuzimba ebifaanaanyi bya molekyu ng'okozesa ebbumba n'obuti** - kino kitegeeza nti abayizi balina okulaga **endabika y'omubiri** (3D geometry) ey'emolekyu.

Nneekebera buli kiyanulo:

B. Mugawanyo gwa birondoozi - Kino kikwata ku Lewis structures naye si kigendererwa ekikulu
C. **Engeri atomu gye zisaasaanyizibwamu mu molekyu nga okusinziira ku VSEPR** - Kino kye kikulu! Okuzimba ebifaanaanyi bya 3D ng'okozesa ebbumba kulaga endabika y'omubiri, era VSEPR ye nkola ekozesebwa okutegeera engeri atomu gye ziteekebwamu mu space
D. Ebikwaso n'ebitakwaso - Si kigendererwa ekikulu

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kuyamba abayizi okutegeera **ebintu ebikozesebwa okumanya obunene bw'ekitundu ky'obulamu bw'akaziba ka leediyoakitiivu** (half-life).

Nnekalakasa buli kyokulabirako:

**B. Teebereza ku nkola y'obuwakiso bw'obusirikale bw'ekintu ekirungo ekya leediyo.**
- Kino kyogera ku military applications, si ku kumanya half-life.

**C. Gattako amawulire okuva mu mmeeza y'ebipimo by'obuzito okukontana n'ebiseera ku nkyukakyuka y'ebintu eby'obusiraamu.**
- Kino kiyamba okutegeera enkyukakyuka mu biseera - kino kisobola okulaga half-life nga tukozesa data n'ebipimo.

**D. Gegeenya okubulukuka kw'akaziba ka leediyoaktifu era okutegeera omuwendo gw'obusirikale obubulukuse.**

**B.** Okulonda akatundu n'okuwaayo olutalo - Kino kikwata ku kunoonyereza naye si ku kulaga ebifo by'ebitundu.

**D. Enfuufu** - Kino kiyinza okuba rusting/oxidation - ekyuma ekifuuka enfuufu. Wadde omuko gusobola okukwata ku kyuma, enfuufu y'ekyuma (rust) tekwatibwa nnyo omuko.

Ekyanulo ekisinga okutuukirira mu context w'okukozesa omuko gw'ekyuma okwolesa abaana abato kyuuka kw'embeera y'ebintu kwe:

- Mu bikolwa ebiyamba obutonde obugunjufu

Nze nja kwetegereza ekibuuzo kino n'obwegendereza:

Ekyanulo ekisinga obulungi kye **A** kubanga kikubiriza omuyizi okulowooza ku "R" omu abuzeewo (Okukendeeza) n'okumulagira okufuna engeri empya.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:
