Ttaala ekiikirira enjuba, olubaawo lukiikirira Ensi, n'akapiira ke kakiikirira omuntu. Bwe batambuuza akapiira, balaba engeri ekisiikirize kyekyuka - kino kulaga enkola y'enjuba ey'okusirikiramu n'okigamba banno.

**D.** Bakiikirira enjuba n'etala, Ensi n'omutwe gwabwe, Omwezi nga bakozesa bbulaani - Kino kulaga enteekateeka y'eggaali, si nkola y'okusirikiramu n'okigamba banno.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okukungaanya obujulizi ku kanyonyi akalaga omutindo gw'ekitundu ekikulu: "Alaga ebitundu by'omubiri bye amanyi ng'abiraga n'engalo bw'aba abiyise."

Ekigendererwa kye: Omwana asobole okulaga ebitundu by'omubiri gwe ng'abiyise amazina.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Omuntu omukulu abuuza omwana ebitundu by'obwenyi bwe we biri - Kino kikebera oba omwana amanyi ebitundu, naye tekimukakasa kulaga n'okuyisa.

**B.** Omuntu omukulu abuuza ku nkola ez'obwongo era asaba omwana akwate ku kitundu ekikwatagana - Kino kikebera okumanya n'okukwata, naye si kulaga n'okuyisa amazina.

**C.** Omuntu omukulu ayimba ennyimba ezikwata ku bitundu by'obwenyi, ng'abikwatako ku mubiri gwe era ng'alaba oba omwana abiddamu - Kino kikebera okwegatta mu nnyimba, naye si kulaga n'okuyisa amazina mu ngeri etegeerekeka.

**D.** Omuntu omukulu akola ebintu ng'akozesa ebitundu by'omubiri (okukuba emikono, okutambuza ebigere n'omutwe) era asaba abaana okukoppa - Kino kikebera okukoppa ebikolwa, naye si kulaga ebitundu n'okubiyisa amazina.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga enkola ey'okukebera oba omwana asobola **okulaga** ebitundu by'omubiri **ng'abiyise amazina**.

**A** ye esembera nnyo kubanga ebuuza omwana "ebitundu by'obwenyi bwe we biri" - kino kimukakasa okulaga n'okuyisa.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kino: "Okuteebereza ebinavaawo olw'ebintu ebibaawo mu butonde bye tulaba, nga tusinziira ku bye tumanyi n'ebyo bye tumaze okuyitamu."

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga abaana:
1. Okuteebereza (okwogerako/okunnyonnyola) ebintu ebibaawo mu butonde
2. Okusinziira ku bye bamanyi n'ebyo bye bayitamu (obumanyirivu bwabwe)

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

**A**: Abaana balaba vidiyo ne boogera ku bye bayitamu mu muyaga - Kino kikozesa obumanyirivu bwabwe obw'edda naye tekiraga nnyo okuteebereza/okunnyonnyola ebinavaamu.

**B**: Abaana balaba okukoppa tsunamii ne babuuzibwa "Kiki ekyabaddewo?" - Kino kiragisa okuteebereza ebinavaamu naye tekisinziira nnyo ku bumanyirivu bwabwe obw'edda.

**C**: Abaana bakola ekisozi ky'omuliro ne babuuzibwa "Muyinza okunnyonnyola kye mulabye? Okuruka kwabaddewo kutya?" - Kino kiragisa okuteebereza/okunnyonnyola ebinavaamu nga basinziira ku kye balaba.

**D**: Abaana boogera ku bumanyirivu bwabwe ku musisi, ne balaba okukoppa omusisi, ne babuuzibwa "Mwandinnyonnyola mutya ekyabaddewo?" - Kino **kitandikira ku bumanyirivu bwabwe obw'edda** (olukungaana lw'emboozi), ne baddamu **okuteebereza/okunnyonnyola** ebyo bye balaba mu kukoppa.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku ngeri omusomesa gy'ayinza okuyamba Antonio okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa ekiri mu mutendera: "Okukuba ebigereko n'ebintu ebigattiddwa n'ebisaanuuke nga tukozesa ebintu ebikozesebwa bulijjo... nga twogera ku nkyukakyuka ezilabika."

Antonio agambye "Njagala amabala g'ossaamu" - kino kiraga nti yeeraliikirira ku langi, naye si ku nkyukakyuka ezilabika mu kugezesa.

Nnekennenya buli ky'omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola:

A. Kino kimukyusa ku bintu ebirala (amazzi n'amafuta) - tekimuyamba ku kiruubirirwa.

B. Kino kyogera ku langi nga "obutuli" - kyogera ku nkyukakyuka, naye omusomesa y'amuwa ekyanulo, si kumugamba akebere.

C. Kino kimubuuza oba alaba **enjawulo** wakati w'ebirangi mu mafuta n'ebyo mu mazzi - kino kimuyamba okwetegereza **nkyukakyuka ezilabika** nga bw'ekimu ku biruubirirwa.

D. Kino kimubuuza ky'aligenda okulaba "ku nkomerero" - naye ekibuuzo kiri ku kye yalaba KATI, si ku nkomerero.

Ekyanulo ekituufu kye:

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku cytoskeleton (omubiri gw'obutoffaali) era omusomesa agenda kukifaananyiza n'ekyuma mu kkolero.

Cytoskeleton ye nkola y'ennyingo mu butoffaali ezikola ng'omubiri oguwanirira obutoffaali, eziyamba mu:
- Okukuuma enkula y'obutoffaali
- Okuwanirira ebintu mu butoffaali
- Okuyamba mu ntambula y'ebintu mu butoffaali

Bwe tunoonya ekifaananyi ekituufu mu kkolero:

A. Ekyuma ekikyusa ebintu ebiramu okubifuula amaanyi - Kino kifaanana ne mitochondria (ebikolera amaanyi)

B. Enkola etegeka ebintu mu ngeri esobozesa ebintu okutereera mu kkolero - Kino kifaanana ne cytoskeleton eyawanirira n'okutegeka entambula mu kkolero

C. Ekifo ekikulu ekikulukusa amawulire - Kino kifaanana ne nucleus (omutwe gw'obutoffaali)

D. Ekyuma ekissa akabonero ku bintu ebiggyibwa - Kino kifaanana ne Golgi apparatus

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okuyamba abayizi okutegeera **omulamwa gw'ekikululo** (osmosis).

Ekikululo kye ntambula y'amazzi okuva mu kifo omuli obuwunga obutono okugenda mu kifo omuli obuwunga obungi, okuyita mu kabindi akalonda (semi-permeable membrane).

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Akatundulu mu mazzi isotonic - Kino kiyinza okulaga entambula y'amazzi naye si kiragiro kirungi nnyo kya kikululo kubanga isotonic kitegeeza nti obuwunga bwe bumu, n'olwekyo entambula y'amazzi teba nnene.

**B.** Omuwumbo mu mazzi agannyogovu vs. agabuguma - Kino kiraga diffusion (okusaasaana) okusinga ekikululo. Omuwumbo gusaasaana mu mazzi, naye si ntambula y'amazzi okuyita mu kabindi akalonda.

**C.** Obuwunga bw'ekyenvu mu bbeka - Kino kiraga diffusion naye si kiragiro kirungi kya kikululo kubanga tewali kabindi akalonda kalabikira wangu.

**D.** Olubaawo olulina ebisenge bibiri ebyawuddwamu akabindi akalekera obutoffaali obutono okuyita - Kino **kiragiro kirungi kya kikululo**. Amazzi gayita mu kabindi okuva mu kisenge omuli obutoffaali obutono okugenda mu kisenge omuli obutoffaali obungi, era omutendera gw'amazzi gukyuka.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi bakwataganye enkulaakulana ennene ey'enkola y'ebinyira munda mu butoffaali n'omulimu gwayo.

Nneebera buli kyokulabirako:

A. Teeka ebifaananyi by'obutoffaali obuzimba ebintu era bamanya omulimu gwa buli kanyama - Kino kiyigiriza ku mimu gy'obutoffaali naye tekikwata ku **nkola y'ebinyira munda** n'enkulaakulana yaayo.

B. Basabe okusiiga ekkubo ly'ebipooli okuyita mu nkola y'okufulumya ebintu - Kino kikwata ku **nkola y'ebinyira munda** (ekkubo ly'ebipooli) n'enkulaakulana yaayo mu butoffaali obuzimba ebintu.

C. Geraageranya emirimu gy'akataffaali akakola obutindo n'ak'emisajja - Kino kigereranya ebika byombi naye tekikwata nnyo ku nkola y'ebinyira munda.

D. Manya omulimu gw'obutonniinya okusinziira ku ndabika - Kino kikwata ku ndabika n'omulimu naye si nnyo ku nkola y'ebinyira munda n'enkulaakulana yaayo.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza: "Butaffaali bwa pulokyaati busobola butya okweyabuluzaamu?"

Ekibuuzo kino kyetaaga okunnyonnyola engeri obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bwe bweyabuluzaamu.

Nnekalakasa buli kiyanulo:

**A.** Kino kinnyonnyola nti obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic buzaala mu ngeri etali ya kikaba (asexual), naye tekinnnyonnyola bulungi engeri gye bweyabuluzaamu.

**B.** Kino kinnyonnyola ku kubaawo kwa DNA naye tekituufu ddala okuddamu ekibuuzo ku ngeri y'okweyabuluza.

**C.** Kino kinnyonnyola "okutomeguka" (cell division) nti kivaamu obutaffaali obupya, naye tekinnnyonnyola mu bujjuvu enkola ennono.

**D.** Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi nti obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bukozesa enkola ya "binary fission" - DNA ekoppebwa, oluvannyuma ekikulukusi ky'obutaffaali ne kyeyawulamu ne kivaamu obutaffaali bubiri obwenkanankana. Kino kinnyonnyola mu bujjuvu engeri obutaffaali bwa prokaryotic bwe bweyabuluzaamu.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekigendererwa: "Okunnyonnyola emisingi gy'ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu."

Ennyingo ya Dalton ku atomu erina emisingi gino:
1. Ebintu byonna bikola atomu ezitayawukana
2. Atomu z'ekintu kimu zifaanagana mu bunene n'obuzito
3. Ekintu ekigatte kikola atomu ez'ebintu eby'enjawulo
4. Mu nkyukakyuka y'ekemiko, atomu zeetabula, ziyawukana, oba zigatta mu ngeri empya

Nnekennenya buli kiragiro:

A. Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo - Kino kikwatagana n'emisingi gya Dalton nti ebintu bigatte bikola atomu ez'ebintu eby'enjawulo ezigatta.

B. Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw'obungi bw'obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky'ekemiko - Kino kikwatagana n'emisingi gya Dalton ku ngeri atomu gye zigatta mu mipimo egigere.

C. Zigikwataganya obuzito bw'ebintu ebiri mu kintu ekigatte n'obuzito bw'ekintu ekigatte kyonna - Kino kikwatagana n'etteeka lya Dalton ery'obuzito obutakyukakyuka.

D. Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu - Kino kikwatagana n'emisingi gya Dalton nti atomu z'ekintu kimu zifaanagana mu buzito.

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okunnyonnyola EMISINGI gya Dalton. Ekiragiro A kye kisinga okunnyonnyola emisingi gya Dalton olw'okuba kitegeeza engeri ebintu gye bigatta (atomu ez'ebintu eby'enjawulo ezigatta).

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukakasa oba abayizi **bategeera omulimu gw'ebiramu ebireetawo emmere** (producer organisms).

Ka ntunuulire buli kirowoozo:

**A. Kituukirize ekifaananyi ky'ekirimwa...** - Kino kiragisa obukugu bw'okukola ekifaananyi, naye tekikakasa bulungi oba omuyizi ategeera ddala omulimu gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere.

**B. Wa ebyokulabirako by'ebiramu ebikola emmere** - Kino kiragisa okujjukira/okumanya ebyokulabirako, naye tekikakasa okutegeera okw'amaanyi kw'omulimu gwabyo.

**C. Singa ebimera bibulawo, kiki ekiyinza okubaawo...** - Kino kiragisa **okutegeera okw'amaanyi** kw'omulimu gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere mu butonde. Omuyizi alina okutegeera nti ebiramu ebikola emmere bye bisookerwamu mu mutimbagiro gw'emmere, era singa bibulawo, ebiramu ebirala byonna bijja kufiira enjala. Kino kikebera okutegeera okw'omutindo ogw'amaanyi.

**D. Teekawo enkolagana...** - Kino kikebera okumanya enkolagana, naye si kw'omulimu gw'ebiramu ebikola emmere mu ngeri ey'enjawulo.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku **nkola y'okubaga ebirowoozo** (hypothesis formation) mu kunoonyereza kwa ssaayansi.

Nkola y'okubaga ebirowoozo etegeeza:
- Okuteekawo endowooza ey'okugezesa eyinza okugezesebwa
- Okuba n'ebibuuzo ebikulu ebisobola okuddibwamu
- Okuba n'endowooza ez'enjawulo ezisobola okugezesebwa

Ka ntunuulire buli ky'okulonda:

**A** - Kuwa ebivuddemu n'endowooza okugikkiriza oba okugigaana - kino kya mu mutendera ogw'oluvannyuma (okwekenneenya ebivuddemu), si mu kuteekawo endowooza.

**B** - Kuteekawo enteekateeka y'okugezesa - kino kya mu mutendera ogw'okukola ekigezeso, si mu kuteekawo endowooza.

**C** - Ekibuuzo ekikulu: "Obubugumu n'obunnyogovu bikola bitya..." - kino kibuuzo kyokka, si ndowooza.

**D** - "Waaliwo endowooza ez'enjawulo ezisobola okuddamu ekibuuzo kino ekikulu... abayizi basobole okulonda ennungi" - Kino kitegeeza okubaga endowooza ez'enjawulo ezisobola okugezesebwa, era kye kigendererwa kya nkola y'okubaga ebirowoozo.

**D**

# Nkola y'Okunoonyereza Ekibuuzo

Nneebaza ekibuuzo kino:

**Ekigendererwa:** Abayizi okutegeera nti ebika by'ebiramu ebiri mu nkolagana ey'okuva mu bintu bye bimu gye byava gye biri kumpi mu byafaayo.

**Ensonga:** Abayizi abamu tebannategeera nsonga eno.

**Ekyetaagisa:** Omulimu oguyamba abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino.

## Okwekenneenya Buli Ky'Okulondamu:

**A. Londa ebimera okusinziira ku ngeri gye bifaanana mu ndabika**
- Kino kiyamba okwawula ebimera okusinziira ku bifaananyi
- Naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'enkolagana y'ebyafaayo

**B. Ddamu ebibuuzo nga osinziira ku kunoonyereza okukoleddwa ku kladogramu**
- Kladogramu laga enkolagana y'ebyafaayo wakati w'ebika
- Kino kikwatagana butereevu n'ekigendererwa

**C. Lambaala dayagula eraga ebyokulabirako by'ebisigalira ebitereevu n'ebitali bitereevu**
- Kino kikwatagana n'enkyukakyuka naye si nnyo ku nkolagana y'ebyafaayo

**D. Gerageranya ebimyuuka by'ebitundu by'omubiri ebitali bikola nnyo**
- Kino kiyamba okulaga enkolagana naye si nkola ennyangu eri abayizi abato

**Ekisingawo:** Kladogramu (B) ye nkola esinga obulungi okulaga enkolagana y'ebyafaayo mu ngeri etegeerekeka.

**B**

Nneeberereza ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku musomesa ow'omwaka ogw'okuna eyagala okuyamba abayizi okutegeera **omugaso gw'okugemesa okw'ekikolimo** mu bulamu bw'abantu, nga kino kigenderera wamu n'**okumanya okw'ekisaayansi**.

Nneekenneenya buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Kunnyonnyola ebyafaayo ku kugemesa (Edward Jenner) - Kino kiyigiriza ebyafaayo naye tekigatta bulungi ku kulaga omugaso mu bulamu bwa kati.

**B.** Okunoonyereza obungi bw'endwadde ezimu nga basinziira ku chati - Kino kiyigiriza ku ndwadde naye tekikwatagana nnyo n'okugemesa.

**C.** Okugeraageranya omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa n'okusaanyizibwawo/okuddamu okubalukawo kw'endwadde - Kino **kiragisa bulungi omugaso gw'okugemesa** nga kiraga enkwatagana wakati w'okugemesa n'okukendeeza ku ndwadde. Era kikozesa obukugu bw'ekisaayansi (okugeraageranya data).

**D.** Okuzimba olukalala lw'ebikulu - Kino kiyigiriza ebyafaayo naye tekigatta ku kulaga omugaso mu bulamu bwa kati.

Ekiyanulo ekituufu kye **C** kubanga kiragisa bulungi omugaso gw'okugemesa nga kiraga enkwatagana wakati w'okugemesa n'okukendeeza ku ndwadde, era kikozesa obukugu bw'ekisaayansi.

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino n'obwegendereza:

Ekigendererwa: Abayizi bategeere omutendera gw'ebisa eggi n'omutendera gw'ennyingo y'omubuto.

Ekibuuzo kye kiri: Buzibu ki mu kutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky'ekibiina ekirabika mu kuddamu kw'omuyizi?

Nneekebera okuddamu kw'omuyizi:
- Omuyizi agamba nti "akalobo kano bwe kamala okukula... kava mu busa bw'eggi"
- Agamba nti "ekitundu ekipya kiyimirira mu busa bw'eggi ekiyitibwa corpus luteum"

Mu nkola entuufu:
- Corpus luteum TEKIVA mu kitundu ekipya ekyeyongera
- Corpus luteum KIVA mu kalobo kano ke kamu ekamaze okuva eggi (follicle eyasoose)
- Kye kitundu kye kimu ekikyuka, si ekitundu ekipya ekyeyongera

Ekibuuzo kye kiri ku nkolagana enkyamu wakati w'ebitundu n'okutegeera obulungi enkola bw'egenda.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nneekebera ekigendererwa n'ebyanulo byonna:

**Ekigendererwa:** "Okutegeera omukwano wakati w'entekateeka y'okukola eby'emmere kw'ebimera n'ey'okussa kw'obutaffaali bw'ebiramu"

Nneekebera buli kyanulo:

**A.** Komawoyo ekyaati eraga enjawulo - Kino kiraga **enjawulo** naye si **omukwano/omukwatagano** wakati w'enkola zombi.

**B.** Ennyonnyola ennene - Eno ennyonnyola bulungi engeri zombi gye zikolera **wamu** n'omukwano gwaazo: okutangaaza kw'ebimera kufulumya okisijeni nga okussa kw'obutaffaali kukozesa okisijeni; okussa kw'obutaffaali kufulumya kaboni dayokisaidi nga okutangaaza kw'ebimera kukozesa kaboni dayokisaidi. Eno eraga bulungi **omukwano** wakati w'enkola zombi.

**C.** Omubalanguzo gw'ebikemiko - Guno gulaga nti ebifulumizibwa mu kimu bye bikozesebwa mu kirala, era guno gulaga **omukwano** gwaazo mu ngeri ey'ekikemiko.

**D.** Lambaala akabonero - Kano kalaga ebitundu n'ebikozesebwa, naye si kyangu kulaba oba kiraga bulungi **omukwano** wakati w'enkola zombi.

Ebyanulo **B** ne **C** byombi biraga omukwano, naye **B** ennyonnyola mu ngeri ennyonnyole ennyo era etegeekeka eri abayizi b'ekibiina ekisooka.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku Fludarabine, eddagala eriziyiza DNA primase. DNA primase ye enzayimu ekola pulayima za RNA (RNA primers) ezeetaagisa mu kukoppololwa kwa DNA.

Bwe kibuuza nti "ddamu ki mu kukoppololwa kwa DNA Fludarabine ly'ekosa butereevu?", kitegeeza nti omuyizi alina okutegeera omulimu gwa DNA primase.

Nnekaliriza ebyokulabirako:

A. **Lagawo ekikolwa kya enzayimu ekikozesebwa mu kukola pulayima ya RNA** - Kino kituufu! DNA primase ekola RNA primers, era Fludarabine bw'eziyiza DNA primase, ekosa omulimu guno.

B. Yawula omulimu gwa enzaimu eyeenyigira mu kumenya sipiira bbiri ezizingiddwa - Kino kwa helicase, si DNA primase.

C. Enjawulo wakati w'omulimu gwa enzaimu eyeenyigira mu kwongera obutaffaali bw'obusirikale - Kino si kya DNA primase.

D. Nnyonnyola engeri enzayimu ekola okumenya obutaffaali bwa haidrojeni - Kino nakyo kwa helicase.

**A**

Nsomooza ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi okukola ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola eby'obwengula ebiri mu nkola y'enjuba, nga yeesigama ku **bunene bw'enjuba n'ebipooli**.

Alina akatebe k'ebibalanguzi omuli omugatte gw'enjuba n'ebipooli ng'akozesa ennyingo y'ekibalangulo.

Neetegereza buli ky'akyayinza okwongerwako:

**A.** Tegeka ebirimu mu ggulu okuva ku kitono okudda ku kinene - Kino kiyamba okutegeera obunene, era kissa essira ku ntereeza (size) mu kifo ky'obuwanvu (distance). Kino kikwatagana n'ekigendererwa.

**B.** Teeka ekibalanguza ky'ensi nga akakodyo akakozesebwa era okole akakolumu akabalirira omuwendo oguli wakati w'ebitundu by'omu bwengula - Kino kikwata ku buwanvu/omugendo, si bunene.

**C.** Ebibuuzo ebya Yee/Nedda ebikwata ku bunene - Kino kiyamba okutegeera obunene mu ngeri ennyangu era kituufu.

**D.** Omulongoosa gw'ennukuta za sayansi - Kino kinzikivu nnyo eri abayizi b'omwaka ogusooka mu ssekendule.

Ekigendererwa kye "okukola ebifaananyi ebinnyonnyola eby'obwengula" nga yeesigama ku **bunene**. Eky'okulabirako **C** kiwa enkola ennyangu era entuufu ey'okutegeera n'okunnyonnyola obunene bw'ebintu mu nkola y'enjuba okuyita mu bibuuzo ebya Yee/Nedda.

**C**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino. Ka nnoonyereze mu butuufu:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku musomesa w'omwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya ng'ateekateeka amasomo ku Kinematics (okutambula kw'ebintu). Agenda kukola omulimu ogunoonya okukwataganya ebirimu by'essomo n'engeri y'ekibalangulo ky'obutonde bw'ensi nga bwe kiri mu ssomero.

Ka nnekennekenye buli kyokulabirako:

A. Bannyonnyola engeri omulamwa gw'okwanguya okukwatagana n'ensi bwe gukozesebwa okugonjoola ebizibu ebya bulijjo - Kino kikwataganya n'engeri y'ekibalangulo ky'obutonde bw'ensi (okukozesa omulamwa okugonjoola ebizibu ebya bulijjo)

B. Banannyonnyola engeri endowooza y'okwanguya okusikirizibwa kw'ensi gy'ekulakulanye mu byafaayo by'omuntu - Kino kikwataganya n'ebyafaayo by'omuntu

C. Bannyonnyola engeri enkulaakulana mu tekinologiya gy'ezzeeko okukkiriza okutuukiriza obutuufu obusingako mu kupima omuwendo gw'amaanyi agasikayo ebintu - Kino kikwataganya n'enkulaakulana mu tekinologiya

D. Banannyonnyola engeri omubiri gye gugwamu nga teguumirizibwa kintu kyonna n'engeri okugwa kuno gye kwesigamye ku bwangu bw'amasoboza agasikayo ebintu - Kino kikwataganya n'obutonde bw'ensi (okugwa kw'ebintu)

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku kugerageranya "omugera gw'amazzi" okuyigiriza ku bizungirizi by'amasannyalaze agolokofu. Tubuuzibwa lwaki engeri eno ey'okugerageranya efuuka ekizibu.

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulonda:

**A.** Kyogera ku misituluzi - naye ekibuuzo tekikwata ku misituluzi.

**B.** Kyogera nti kizzaamu abayizi amaanyi okukkiriza nti amasannyalaze "gasobola okukka" mu waya naye "tegasobola kwambuka" - Kino kya mazima ddala kubanga amazzi gasobola okukka mu payipu naye tegasobola kwambuka ebweru w'epayipu. Naye amasannyalaze mu nkola entuufu gasobola kwambuka (okuyita mu radiation, electromagnetic waves). Kino kireetera okutegeera okw'obukyamu.

**C.** Kyogera ku kutakkiriza bayizi kukwataganya mulamwa gw'obusitoowa - naye kino si kizibu kikulu mu kugerageranya kuno.

**D.** Kyogera ku mugendo gw'amasannyalaze - naye omugendo gw'amasannyalaze (speed of light) si gwe mulamwa mukulu mu kugerageranya kuno.

Ekizibu ekikulu mu kugerageranya amazzi n'amasannyalaze kiri mu nti: amazzi gatambula nga gali munda mu payipu era tegasobola kwambuka ebweru, naye amasannyalaze gasobola okutambula mu bbanga era gasobola kwambuka (radiation).

**B**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino ekikwata ku kuyigiriza ebikwata ku bifaananyi mu ndabirwamu empanvu ne mu ndabirwamu enkovu.

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Kino kinnyonnyola bulungi enjawulo wakati w'ekifaananyi ekituufu (real image) n'ekifaananyi ekyekiise (virtual image) mu ngeri ennyangu era etegeerekeka eri omwana w'omwaka ogusooka. Kikozesa ekijiiko nga ekyokulabirako ekyangu okuzuula - omwana asobola okukikebera n'amaaso ge.

**B.** Kino si kituufu. Ebifaananyi ebituufu tebibeera bikkiddwa waggulu okudda wansi bulijjo, era ebifaananyi ebyekiise tebibeera bitereevu bulijjo.

**C.** Kino kiyinza okutabulatabula omwana omuto kubanga tekinyonnyola bulungi enjawulo wakati w'ebifaananyi ebyo mu ngeri ey'amagezi era ey'obukodyo.

**D.** Kino kizibuwavu nnyo eri omwana w'omwaka ogusooka. Okwogera ku "kugaziwa kw'emiryango gy'omusana" n'okulagula emiryango" si kya magezi eri omwana omuto.

Ekintu ekisinga obulungi kwe kuwa okulabirako okw'obukodyo omwana kw'asobola okukebera - nga bw'ali mu kirowoozo **A**.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku kimmanyi ki abayizi ba S.1 kye beetaaga okuba nga baakimanyiira dda okusobola okutegeera ebikolwa by'amasoboza ng'okweyoleka n'okumenyeka kw'ekitangaala.

Okweyoleka (reflection) n'okumenyeka (refraction) kw'ekitangaala bye bikolwa ebikulu eby'amasoboza. Okusobola okutegeera ebikolwa bino:

- **Okweyoleka** kwe kuba ekitangaala bwe kikuba ku ntandikwa n'ekiddira ebbali
- **Okumenyeka** kwe kuba ekitangaala bwe kikyuka mu mbeera yaakyo nga kiyita mu bintu eby'enjawulo

Ekimmanyi ekisinga obukulu okutegeera ebikolwa bino kwe kutegeera nti **ekitangaala kitambula mu lunyiriri olugolokofu** (straight lines). Kino kye kimusingi ekikulu okumanya nga ekitangaala bwe kitambula, era kyetaagisa okusobola okutegeera lwaki ekitangaala kyeyoleka oba kyemenyeka.

Ebirala (B, C, D) bya maanyi naye si bya musingi nnyo ng'okutegeera okutambula kw'ekitangaala mu lunyiriri olugolokofu.

**A**

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okuzuula **endowooza bbiri enkyamu** eziyinza okulemesa okuyiga amateeka ga Newton.

**A. Obugazi n'obuwunzike amakulu gaabwo gefaanagana; amaanyi agetaagisa okusobola okukakasa ekintu okutambula gyesigamiziddwa ku buzito bw'ekintu ekyo.**
- Obugazi n'obuwunzike si bimukwaano - kino KIKYAMU
- Amaanyi agetaagisa okutambula tegasigamiziddwa ku buzito bwokka - kino KIKYAMU
- Kino kirina endowooza BBIRI enkyamu ✓

**B. Omubiri bwe guba nga tegunyeenya, tewabaawo maanyi gakukolerako; embiro zongera zigenda mu kkubo limu n'engeri omubiri gye gutambula.**

- Embiro zigenda mu kkubo eriwaŋŋangana n'omugendo - KIKYAMU
- Kino kirina endowooza BBIRI enkyamu ✓

- Ekifo kiyinza okwogerwako nga reference point - kino KITUUFU
- Ebitali biramu nabyo bisobola okukozesa amaanyi - KIKYAMU
- Kino kirina endowooza EMU enkyamu

**D. Obukwakulizo buli kiseera buzziŋŋamya omugendo; amaanyi agaterekebwa akantu akatono ku kanene matono okusinga amaanyi agazzibwawo akanene ku katono.**
- Obukwakulizo si buli kiseera buzziŋŋamya (constant friction) - KIKYAMU
- Newton's 3rd law: amaanyi ga action ne reaction genkana - KIKYAMU
- Kino kirina endowooza BBIRI enkyamu ✓

Naye nga nfumiitiriza ku mateeka ga Newton n'endowooza ezisinga okukyamu:

Nkebera ekigendererwa: "Okulaga nti bategeera nti okumanya ebikwata ku Bwengula kukyuka era kweyongera okusinziira ku bujulizi obupya."

Wakati wa C ne D, D y'esinga obulungi okukiikirira ekigendererwa kubanga erimu ekyokulabirako ekituufu eky'okukyuka kw'okumanya (okuva ku geocentric okudda ku heliocentric) okusinziira ku bujulizi obupya.

Nneetegereza buli kirowoozo:

- Kino kikola okukebera mu ngeri ey'omubiri/okunoonyereza
- Kisobozesa omusomesa okulaba abayizi bwe bakola n'okutegeera kye balina

**B. Baddamu ebibuuzo ebigendereddwa okugeraageranya n'okusuubira obungi bw'ebiseera...**
- Kino kikebera kumanya kw'endowooza yokka
- Si kukebera mu ngeri ey'omubiri

**C. Balaga mu kiifananyi obwolekera bw'amasoboza...**

- Kino kikebera kumanya kw'endowooza/theory yokka
- Si kukebera mu ngeri ey'omubiri

Ekikolwa ekisinga okuwa omusomesa **obukakafu obusinga obulungi** ku kumanya abayizi kye balina edda kwe **kukola mu ngeri ey'omubiri** - okusuula ebintu n'okulaba kye bakola.

Omuyizi agambye nti "Omusinde gukyuka kubanga gyesigamiziddwa ku bugazi bw'amayengo n'obuwanvu bwago, era byombi bikyuka mu kigambululo kya Doppler."

Nneekebeza buli kiyanulo:

# Okwekenneenya Ekibuuzo

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okutegeera kiki abayizi kye balina okuba nga baamaze okuyiga okusobola **okunnyonnyola ebintu ebireetera atomu okuba entebenkevu mu nyukiriya**.

Atomu okuba entebenkevu mu nyukiriya kiva ku:
- Ensengeka y'akaziba (nucleus) - namba y'obuziba (protons)
- Ebibangirizi by'amasoboza ag'akaziba (electron configuration/shells)
- Engeri electrons bwe zisengekebwa mu masoboza ag'ebweru

Okusobola okunnyonnyola entebenkevu ya atomu, abayizi balina okutegeera:
- Akaziba kalina protons (obuziba obulungi) ne neutrons
- Amasoboza ag'akaziba galina electrons (obuziba obubi)
- Ensengeka y'electrons mu masoboza ag'ebweru y'ereetera entebenkevu ya nyukiriya

**Ekyokulabirako D** kyogera ku "Akaziba n'ebibangirizi by'amasoboza ag'akaziba" - kino kye kintu ekikulu okutegeera entebenkevu ya atomu mu nyukiriya.

D. Okutondeka ebirungo by'ebiramu eby'enjawulo nga tukozesa amannya ga IUPAC - Kino kikwatagana n'okutondeka n'amannya, si bibinja ebikola

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: okulaga nti ekyokya ekikwatiddwa kisinziira ku **bwangu bw'ekyokya obwa buli kintu**.

Nneetegeera buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Bbaatiira amazzi n'ekiro ebyenkana obuzito mu bbiika ez'enjawulo era opime tempulikya esooka ne tempulikya ey'enkomerero oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera ekigereke.

- Kiyinza okulaga nti ebintu eby'enjawulo bikwata ekyokya mu ngeri ez'enjawulo (bwangu bw'ekyokya obw'enjawulo)

**B.** Teeka amazzi agookya mu bikopo bibiri bye bimu (gilasi ne ffoamu)
- Kino kigezesa ebikopo eby'enjawulo, si bintu eby'enjawulo

**C.** Bbugumya amazzi amalongoofu n'ag'omunnyo
- Kino kigezesa amazzi ag'enjawulo nga gafuumukira, si kukwata ekyokya

**D.** Bbugumya akajiiko k'ekyuma mu mazzi
- Kino kigezesa okusiiga ekyokya, naye si kugezesa bwangu bw'ekyokya obw'ebintu eby'enjawulo

Ekirowoozo **A** kisinga okutuukana n'ekigendererwa kubanga kigezesa ebintu bibiri eby'enjawulo (amazzi n'ekiro) okukakasa nti bikwata ekyokya mu ngeri ez'enjawulo - kino kye kigendererwa ky'okulaga nti bwangu bw'ekyokya bwa buli kintu bw'enjawulo.

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okutegeera ebintu ebyesigamiziddwa n'ebitali byesigamiziddwa mu bintu ebikola ku nkola y'omusaayi omukadde"

Nneetegeera buli kyokulabirako:

A. Gerageranya endabika y'omusuulo mu muntu omulamu n'omuntu alina sukaali - Kino kikwata ku musuulo, ekiri mu nkola y'omusaayi omukadde, era kilaga enjawulo wakati w'embeera ezimu (omuntu omulamu vs. alina sukaali).

B. Zimba akataabo akalaga engeri omwenge gwe gakyusaamu obungi bw'omusuulo - Kino kikwata ku musuulo era kilaga engeri ekintu (omwenge) gye kikola ku musuulo.

C. Kkompleeta tebuleni ewandiika langi y'omusuulo mu biseera bya lunaku eby'enjawulo - Kino kikwata ku musuulo era kilaga enkyukakyuka mu langi.

D. Maliriza eggereesa nga olaga omuwendo gw'ebintu eby'enjawulo mu bitundu by'omusuwa gw'ensigo - Kino kikwata ku musuwa gw'ensigo, ekiri mu nkola y'okumansira emmere, si nkola y'omusaayi omukadde.

Ekigendererwa kyogera ku "ebintu ebyesigamiziddwa n'ebitali byesigamiziddwa" - kino kitegeeza okwawula ebintu ebikola ku nkola y'omusaayi omukadde. Ekyokulabirako A kilaga bulungi enjawulo wakati w'embeera bbiri (ebyesigamiziddwa/ebitali byesigamiziddwa).

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okutegeera omukwano wakati w'ebbugumu n'obungi bw'empewo mu bulamu obwa bulijjo."

Nneetegeera buli ky'okulabirako:

A. Enkola y'ekyoto ekifumbisa mu bwangu (pressure cooker) - Kino kiragisa bulungi omukwano wakati w'ebbugumu n'obungi bw'empewo. Ebbugumu bwe lyeyongera mu kyoto, empewo eyongera obungi n'amaanyi.

B. Obuwombeefu bw'omugaati obukolebwa n'ekizimbulukusa - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka y'ekizimbulukusa naye si ky'okulabirako ekitegeerekeka ennyo ku mukwano wakati w'ebbugumu n'obungi bw'empewo.

C. Okuyingiza n'okufulumya omukka mu mawuggwe - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'okussa omukka naye si ky'okulabirako ekitegeerekeka ennyo ku mukwano gw'ebbugumu n'obungi bw'empewo.

D. Okukolebwa kw'obusaanikira bw'ebbampuuyi nga gguloopinga eccupa ya soda - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka y'ekikemikolo naye si ky'okulabirako ekitegeerekeka ennyo ku mukwano gw'ebbugumu n'obungi bw'empewo.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kino kikwata ku kusobola okutereeza okutegeera okw'abayizi okutali kutuufu okukwata ku ngeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu. Abayizi balowooza nti keyoni zikolebwa nga atomu "efuna" polotooni, naye mu nkola ey'ennono, ayoni zikolebwa nga atomu efuna oba efiirwa **elekitulooni** (electrons), si polotooni.

Ka ntunuulire buli mulimu:

**A.** Kuno kusaba abayizi okubala polotooni, elekitulooni ne nyutulooni mu ayoni - kino kiyinza okuyamba naye tekikozesa nkola ey'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi.

**B.** Kuno kusaba abayizi okukola akatebe awamu n'omusomesa - kino kiyinza okuyamba okutegeerera naye tekiwa abayizi mukisa okwekenneenya era okukulaakulanya obukugu bw'okunoonyereza.

**C.** Kuno kusaba okukola ekibalanguwa - kino kiyigiriza amakulu g'ebigambo naye tekiyamba nnyo mu kutegeera engeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu.

**D.** Kuno kusaba abayizi **okugeraageranya** atomu ya sodium entaanu n'ayoni ya sodium (sodium ion/cation), nga balowooza ku muwendo gwa polotooni, elekitulooni ne nyutulooni. Kino kiyamba abayizi okuzuula nti omuwendo gwa polotooni tegujja kukyuka, naye omuwendo gwa elekitulooni gwe gukyuka. Kino kikozesa obukugu bw'okunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi era kiyamba abayizi okwekenneenya n'okuzuula ensobi mu kutegeera kwabwe.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyebuuza ku bintu abayizi kye bateekwa **okusobola okwawulawo nga tebannatandika kusomesebwa** ku mutindo ogw'okusatu ogw'obwerinde (adaptive immunity).

Omutindo ogw'okusatu ogw'obwerinde guzingiramu:
- Obutaffaali bwa B (bukola antibodies)
- Obutaffaali bwa T (bukola cell-mediated immunity)
- Okujjukira kw'omubiri (immunological memory)

Abayizi bateekwa okusooka okutegeera ebintu by'omusingi nga tebannatuuka ku mutindo ogw'okusatu:

**A. Enjawulo wakati w'ekizibiti n'akawuka akireeta** - Kino kya musingi nnyo. Abayizi bateekwa okusooka okutegeera kye kizibiti (pathogen) n'engeri gye kyawukana n'endwadde (disease) nga tebannatuuka ku nkola ez'amaanyi ez'okwerinda.

**B. Enjawulo wakati w'emirimu gy'obutaffaali bwa B ne T** - Kino kiri mu mutindo ogw'okusatu gwennyini, si kintu kya kusooka.

**C. Okukkiriza n'okujjukira kw'omubiri** - Kino nakyo kiri mu mutindo ogw'okusatu gwennyini.

**D. Okutolokwa okw'amaanyi n'obutonde bw'omubiri** - Kino kya musingi naye si kya nkizo nnyo nga A.

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyogera ku etteeka lya Hooke, erikwata ku maanyi g'omutunziro. Etteeka lya Hooke linnyonnyola nti amaanyi ageetaagisa okugololola oba okusindika omutunziro gakwatagana butereevu n'obuwanvu omutunziro gwe gugololeddwa (F = -kx).

Okutegeera etteeka lino, omuyizi alina okuba nga yamaze okuyiga:

**Ekyokulabirako A**: Okikiikirira obunene, obwolekero, n'engeri y'amaanyi gye gakolamu - Kino kikulu nnyo kubanga etteeka lya Hooke likwata ku maanyi (obunene bwaago n'obwolekero bwaago) n'engeri amaanyi gye gakola ku mutunziro.

**Ekyokulabirako B**: Omukwano wakati w'amaanyi g'obuzito n'enkyukakyuka - Kino tekikwatagana nnyo ne etteeka lya Hooke.

**Ekyokulabirako C**: Enjawulo y'amaanyi ag'enkanankana oba agaddawo - Kino si kya nkizo nnyo ku etteeka lya Hooke.

**Ekyokulabirako D**: Okutegeera engeri amaanyi gye gakosaamu enkula n'entambula - Kino tekikwatagana butereevu ne etteeka lya Hooke.

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**A**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga okulaba ekiraga nti ekiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga kituukiddwako: "Okunnyonnyola engeri ggaasi ennungi gye zeeyisaamu mu mbeera eza bulijjo, nga otunuulira amateeka agigoberera."

Ebikulu mu kiruubirirwa kino:
- Okunnyonnyola engeri ggaasi ennungi gye zeeyisaamu
- Mu mbeera eza bulijjo
- Nga otunuulira amateeka agigoberera

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. Bakozesa amateeka ga Boyle, Gay-Lussac, ne Charles mu ngeri etali ya kubala - Kino kyogera ku kukozesa amateeka naye tekikakasa bulungi okunnyonnyola mu mbeera eza bulijjo.

B. Bannyonnyola ebifa mu ggulaafu - Kino kyetunuulira nnyo ku ggulaafu, si ku kunnyonnyola mu mbeera eza bulijjo.

C. Balaga mu bulamu obwa bulijjo obungi bw'ebipimo by'ebintu eby'omukka omungi n'ebipimo by'obugumu bwabyo - Kino kyogera ku "bulamu obwa bulijjo" era ku "balaga" engeri ggaasi gye zeeyisaamu (ebipimo by'obungi n'obugumu).

D. Bakubalira omuwendo - Kino kyetunuulira nnyo ku kubalira, si ku kunnyonnyola mu mbeera eza bulijjo.

**C**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okukakasa akabonero kano: "Okwaawula ebintu ebiyisa amasannyalaze okuva ku bitabiyisa"

Kino kitegeeza abayizi balina okumanya:
- Ebintu ki ebikwatibwa amasannyalaze (ebiyisa amasannyalaze)
- Ebintu ki ebitakwatibwa amasannyalaze (ebitabiyisa)

Nnekennenya buli kikolwa:

A. Kwetegereza ekikolwa ky'amasannyalaze ekikola n'ogutakola - Kino kikwata ku nkola y'amasannyalaze naye tekikwata nnyo ku kwaawula ebintu ebiyisa n'ebitabiyisa.

B. Kwetegereza akataambi k'amasannyalaze agatambulira mu byuma - Kino kikwata ku maanyi g'amasannyalaze mu byuma eby'enjawulo, si ku kwaawula ebiyisa n'ebitabiyisa.

C. Lwaki omuntu alina okwambala engalo za laaba - Kino kikwata ku bukuumi, si ku kwaawula ebiyisa n'ebitabiyisa.

D. Laga ekifaananyi ky'akazinga k'amasannyalaze era abasabe okulonda mu bintu (foorka ey'ekyuma, kamuyooyo ow'omu polasitika, akakaba ak'omu labba) ekiyinza okuggusa akazinga - Kino KIKWATA BUTEREEVU ku kwaawula ebintu ebiyisa amasannyalaze (ekyuma) okuva ku bitabiyisa (polasitika, labba).

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekibuuzo kyetaaga omuyizi okulaga nti atuukidde ku kabonero ka: "Okutawula ebipimo ebikozesebwa okunnyonnyola ekikankano ky'ettaka"

Kino kitegeeza omuyizi alina okutegeera n'okukozesa ebipimo (nga ekipimo kya Richter) ebikozesebwa okupima amaanyi g'emisisi.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Kulonda ensindikiriro y'omusisi - Kino kikwata ku nsibuko y'omusisi, si ku bipimo

B. Okunoonyereza ku musisi eyasinga obunene - Kino kya byafaayo, naye si kukozesa bipimo

C. Okulonda ensobi mu nkozesa y'ebigambo - Kino kikwata ku bigambo, si ku bipimo

D. Enjawulo wakati w'obubonero bubiri ku kipimo kya Richter mu buwero bw'amaanyi - Kino KIKOZESA ddala ekipimo (Richter scale) era kitegeeza engeri ebipimo bino gye bikolagana n'amaanyi agasumululwa

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**D**

Nneekebeza ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza lwaki bageraageranya amino asidi za puloteni nga DNA y'erimu amawulire. Omusomesa alina okuddamu ng'annyonnyola engeri amino asidi sequences gye zikwatagana ne DNA n'engeri gye zisobola okukozesebwa okuteebereza enkolagana z'ebika.

Nneekebera buli ddamu:

**A**: Egamba nti ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okubaawo mu bika eby'enjawulo, era okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo mu genes n'amino acid sequences, enkolagana zisobola okuteeberezebwa. Kino kituufu naye tekinyonnyola bulungi engeri amino asidi gye ziva mu DNA.

**B**: Ennyonnyola bulungi nti puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu amino asidi ekkodeddwa mu DNA. Bwe wabaawo enkyukakyuka mu DNA, kino kikyusa amino acid sequence. N'olwekyo, nga tutunuulira enjawulo mu amino acid sequences, omuntu ayinza okumanya engeri ebika gye bikwatagana mu nkulaakulana. Kino kiddamu bulungi ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi.

**C**: Egamba nti puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu RNA, era enkyukakyuka zisobola okulagibwa mu amino acid sequences. Kino kituufu naye tekinyonnyola bulungi enkolagana wakati wa DNA n'amino asidi.

**D**: Egamba nti amino acid sequence esalibwawo codons ku RNA, era enkyukakyuka zisobola okukyusa puloteni. Kino kituufu naye kijjudde ebikulu eby'omutindo gwa molecular biology ekiyinza okutasobola kumanyibwa bulungi omuyizi wa S1.

Ekiddamu ekisinga obulungi era ekinyonnyola mu ngeri ennyangu enkolagana wakati wa DNA, amino asidi, n'engeri gye zikozesebwa okuteebereza enkolagana z'ebika kiri:

**B**

Nneebaza okubuuza kino ekikwata ku ssaayansi y'obuzaale n'okukyusa obuziizi.

Nneekebera buli kirowoozo:

**A.** Kinnyonnyola nti akataffaali kalina okuba nga tekannakyuka era nga kalimu ebintu ebireetera okukyuka - kino si kituufu nnyo kubanga obuziizi obweteereddwamu bwava mu kataffaali akakyuse (differentiated cell).

**B.** Kinnyonnyola bulungi nti oosayiti (egg cell) lwe butaffaali obutannakyuka obulina obusobozi okukulaakulana. Ekisinga obukulu, kinnyonnyola nti cytoplasm y'e egg erimu ebintu ebiyamba okwawula ebika by'obutaffaali nga bisunsula ebikolwa by'okuwandiika n'okuvvuunula ebiri mu buziizi obuteereddwamu. Kino kye kituufu - egg cell erimu "reprogramming factors" eziddiza obuziizi obukyuse okudda mu mbeera y'okutannakyuka.

**C.** Kinnyonnyola nti obutaffaali obulala bulina ebintu ebikubiriza okuggyawo obutaffaali obwetaagisa - kino si kituufu kubanga obutaffaali bwonna bulina DNA ye yimu.

**D.** Kinnyonnyola nti obutaffaali bw'omu lubuto bulina ebintu byonna ebyetaagisa - kino kituufu naye si nnyonnyola ennungi ey'ensonga lwaki egg cell lyokka lye likozesebwa.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omuyizi abuuza nti bwe basanga omuntu alina **IgG** naye **si IgM** mu musaayi, kitegeeza ki?

Nnelowooza ku nkola ya antibodies:
- **IgM** ye antibody esooka okujja ng'omuntu akasirikiddwa (acute/early infection)
- **IgG** ejja oluvannyuma, naye esigala mu musaayi okumala ebbanga ddene (past infection/recovery)

Bwe basanga omuntu alina **IgG yokka** (si IgM), kitegeeza:
- IgM emaze okuggwaako (si kiseera kya kaakano eky'obulwadde)
- IgG esigalawo - omuntu yali alwadde edda era awona, oba alina obukuumi

Nnelowooza ku buli kiyanulo:

A. Tegituufu - IgG ne IgM si za "ntikko y'obulwadde obukambwe"

B. Tegituufu - bwe waba n'IgG yokka (si IgM), si "kiseera ekibaawo amangu"

C. Tegituufu - "kitundu ekisooka" kyandibadde IgM, si IgG yokka

D. **KITUUFU** - Kinnyonnyola bulungi nti IgM esooka, oluvannyuma IgG, ate IgG esigala okumala ebbanga ddene. Bwe basanga IgG yokka, omuntu awona.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala abayizi bategeere "engeri ebizimba bya kansa gye bikolebwa" (how cancer cells are formed).

Kansa evaamu nga waliwo enkyukakyuka (mutations) mu DNA ezireeta obutafugibwa bulungi bw'okugabanyika kw'ebitundu by'obutaffaali. Ebizimba bya kansa bigabanyika awatali kufugibwa - ekigabanyo ekitali kya bulijjo.

Nnekennenya buli kiruubirirwa:

A. Ebiseera by'omutendera gw'obulamu bw'akataffaali - Kino kikwata ku nkulaakulana ya bulijjo, naye si kikulu nnyo mu kutegeera kansa.

B. Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosis - Kino KIKULU nnyo! Kansa evaamu nga mitosis (ekigabanyo ky'ebitundu by'obutaffaali) etafugibwa bulungi. Abayizi balina okutegeera engeri mitosis gy'ekola mu bulijjo okusobola okutegeera engeri gy'ekyonooneka mu kansa.

C. Ebifo omukutu gwe kikula ky'obutaffaali mwe guyita - Kino kikwata ku cell cycle naye si kye kintu ekikulu ennyo.

D. Ebika by'enkyukakyuka mu DNA ne mu chromosome - Kino nakyo kikulu, naye abayizi balina okusooka okutegeera mitosis (ekigabanyo) okusobola okutegeera engeri enkyukakyuka gye zireeta okugabanyika okutali kwa bulijjo.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye kunnyonnyola engeri omukutu gw'obubonero bw'obusimu gye gukwataganyaamu ebikolwa by'ekiramu okusobola okwetoloola embeera ng'okuyita mu bubonero obuweerezebwa obutaffaali bw'obusimu okwetoloola omubiri gwonna.

Ekigendererwa kino kyetaaga:
- Okunnyonnyola engeri omukutu gw'obubonero bw'obusimu gye gukola
- Okukwataganya ebikolwa by'ekiramu (reflexes)
- Okwetegereza bubonero obutaffaali bw'obusimu

Nnekennenya buli kiyanulo:

A. Bakebera ebifaananyi eby'ebikolwa ebyangu ebya reflekisi era ne basobola okwawula ebitundu byabyo - Kino kikwata ku bikolwa by'ekiramu naye tekinyonnyola engeri omukutu gye gukola.

B. Bannyonnyola enkyukakyuka ezilabika mu ngeri omubiri gwe gwewangamu okusinziira ku maanyi agukubye - Kino kikwata ku nkyukakyuka naye si ku mukutu gw'obubonero bw'obusimu.

C. Bannyonnyola engeri ebizimba by'obutoffaali bw'obwongo gye bikolebwamu, ekisobozesa okukola ebika by'okuddamu ebitali bimu - Kino kikwata ku bwongo naye si ku mukutu gwonna.

D. Banannyonnyola omukulu gw'omugongo, obwongo, ebintu ebiwulira, n'ebikola mu nteekateeka y'okuddamu kw'obubonero bw'obwongo - Kino kinnyonnyola OMUKUTU GWONNA (omugongo, obwongo, ebiwulira, ebikola) mu nteekateeka y'okuddamu - kino kye kigendererwa.

**D**

Nnekennenya ekigendererwa: "Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale"

Etteeka lino liyigiriza nti mu nkola enzigale (closed system), omugatte gw'amaanyi gusigala nga gwe gwe gumu - amaanyi tegabuuka wadde okweyongera.

Nnekennenya buli kyokulabirako:

A. Obutomere - kino kikwata ku bintu ebitakyuka mu nkola, naye si kikulu nnyo ku maanyi.

B. Okugezesa obuzito bw'emmotoka nga tezinnaba kutomeragana ne nga zimaze okutomeragana - Kino kiragisa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka. Mu kutomeragana, amaanyi gakyusibwa okuva mu ngeri emu okudda mu ndala, naye omugatte gw'amaanyi gusigala nga gwe gwe gumu. Okupima obuzito bwa nga n'oluvannyuma kiraga nti obungi bw'amaanyi busigala nga bwe bwali.

C. Kino kikwata ku mulimu (work) = amaanyi × olubatu, si ku tteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka.

D. Okugong'ana kwa bibiina - kino kisobola okulaga etteeka ly'amaanyi, naye tekikakasibwa bulungi.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa: "Okukozesa omutindo gw'amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala **kyeyoleka** era ne **kimenyeka** bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri."

Ebikulu mu kigendererwa:
- Okukozesa omutindo gw'amayengo (hands-on/practical)
- Okulaga nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka (reflection)
- Okulaga nti ekitangaala kimenyeka (refraction)
- Bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri

Nnekennenya buli ky'okulonda:

**A** - Ekitundu ky'ekitabo - Kino kya theory, si hands-on/practical

**B** - Okutengejja okw'ekikompyuta - Kino kilaga refraction mu mazzi, naye si hands-on practice nga abaana be bakikola

**C** - Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza nga gukuba amazzi - Kino **hands-on**, kilaga **reflection** (okuddamu waggulu) ne **refraction** (okumenyeka ku mpalazo), era kikozesa ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri (omukka ne mazzi)

**D** - Omulimu ku kompyuta - Kino simulation, si hands-on practice

Ekyanulo ekituufu:

**C**

Nneekebera ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa alina ekizibu: abayizi abamu tebasobola kukwataganya etteeka ly'amaanyi agasikayo (gravity) n'ebyokulabirako ebilaga (appo egwa oba omwezi ogukulungulula Ensi).

Ekigendererwa: okwongera okutegeera kw'abayizi n'okutangaza okutabuka kwabwe.

Nneekebera buli kyokulabirako:

**A.** Akapiira ku mugwa - kino kikyusa ensonga okuva ku gravity okudda ku centripetal force. Kino kiyinza okutabulatabula abayizi okusinga kubayamba.

**B.** Enyonyoza ekiraga ekintu ekipima obuzito kinene ekikiikiriza Ensi - kino kiwa ekifaananyi ekirabika eky'engeri gravity gye ekola, ekiraga obuzito obunene bwe bukwataganya n'obutonotono, n'engeri ebintu gye biyinza okwetoloola. Kino kiyamba abayizi okulaba ekifaananyi eky'omubiri.

**C.** Ejjulo ly'emmwanyi n'akapiira - kino kikyusa ensonga okudda ku centrifugal force n'embiro, si gravity nnamba.

**D.** Akabonero ku lubaawo - kino kya theory nnyo, era abayizi bano baali tebasobola kukwataganya n'ebyokulabirako ebya bulijjo, kale akabonero akakalu tekabayambe nnyo.

Ekyanulo ekisinga obulungi kye **B** - kiwa ekifaananyi eky'omubiri ekirabika eky'engeri gravity gye ekola, ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okulaba n'okutegeera obulungi.

**B**

Nnekennenya ekibuuzo kino:

Omusomesa ayagala okusomesa ebikwata ku mayengo n'amaloboozi. Abirowoozo abaweereddwa gali mangi nnyo. Kibuuzibwa birowoozo ki ebibiri ebisooka by'alina okukolako okusobola okukulaakulanya okuyiga ebiri ku lukalala oluwanvu.

Mu kuyigiriza ssaayansi, ebirowoozo ebikulu eby'omusingi (fundamental concepts) birina okusooka okuyigirizibwa nga tebinnaba kuyigiriza ebirala ebizibu. Mu mayengo n'amaloboozi:

- **Omugatte gw'emirundi (Frequency)** n'**obuwanvu bw'amayengo (Wavelength)** bye birowoozo by'omusingi ebinnyonnyola obulombolombo bw'omuyengo. Bino bye birowoozo ebikulu eby'omusingi ebiyamba okutegeera ebirala byonna ebiri ku lukalala (nga obunene bw'eddoboozi, amaanyi, embiro z'okusaasaana, n'ebirala).

Ebirala nga amagezi (energy), okunkunuka (reflection), okutomebwa (absorption) bisobola okuyigirizibwa oluvannyuma ng'omusingi gumaze okutegerekeka.

**B**

Nneebaza ekibuuzo kino ekikwata ku ngeri omuyizi gy'akolaamu okukakasa nti ategeera embeera ya Doppler.

Embeera ya Doppler ekwata ku nkyukakyuka y'omuwendo gw'eddoboozi (oba frequency y'amayengo) olw'omuvuduko wakati w'ekintu ekiweereza amayengo n'omuwerekereza.

Ka ntunuulire buli kyokulabirako:

A. Kino kyogera ku nnyigiriza/okwawukanya kw'amayengo - si kye kikulu mu Doppler effect.

B. Kino kyogera ku kunoonyereza omuwendo gw'eddoboozi - naye si kye kikulu mu kutegeera embeera ya Doppler.

**D**

Nnekennenya buli kirowoozo:

Nneekebeza ekibuuzo kino:

Ekigendererwa kye "Kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola ebikwaata ku physicochemical properties z'ebintu ebirina obutonde bw'obutonde."

1. **Okutegeka** - okusengeka data

Nneekebeza buli kirowoozo:

**A** - Baweebwa data, basabe okukekkereza mbeera. Kino kikola **okukekkereza** naye si kutegeka wadde okunnyonnyola.

Ekifo **B** kye kisinga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kubanga abayizi bennyini **banoonyereza**, **batege** data yaabwe, era **balambulule/bannyonnyole** ebiva.

**B**
